import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveReferenceCollarFactory

/-!
# The actual positive collar at a prescribed admissible width

This is the same integral primitive as the existing collar factory.
The width is supplied with its explicit finite-jet and mass margins;
its displayed derivative lower bound is retained for later estimates.
This file is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def prescribedPositiveCollarLower (l r δ m κ Lref : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  m * min (min (κ / 2) Lref / m) ((1 / 2) / positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ)

/-- The same factory handles a left root or a right root. Only the given
finite root data and the actual reference slope are bounded as inputs. -/
theorem positiveReferenceCollar_family_of_width
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} {A : ι → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {Ref : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {l r δ ρ κ M Lref Mref v m : ℝ} (root : Bool)
    (hlr : l < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hLref : 0 < Lref) (hMref : 0 ≤ Mref) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ < ρ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (hgap : 2 * δ < r - l)
    (hsmall : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * δ ≤ κ / 2)
    (hmass : 2 * (max (M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M) Mref) * δ ≤ m / 2)
    (hA : ∀ i j, j ≤ n + 1 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (A i j))
    (hAvalue : ∀ i θ, A i 0 θ = if root then v + m else v)
    (hAlow : ∀ i θ, κ ≤ A i 1 θ)
    (hAbound : ∀ i j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ, |A i j θ| ≤ M)
    (hRef : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ref)
    (hRefValue : ∀ side, side ≠ root → ∀ θ,
      Ref (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then v + m else v)
    (hRefLow : ∀ side, side ≠ root → ∀ x,
      x ∈ Metric.ball (if side then r else l) ρ → ∀ θ,
        Lref ≤ radialPartial Ref (x, θ))
    (hRefBound : ∀ side, side ≠ root → ∀ x,
      x ∈ Metric.ball (if side then r else l) ρ → ∀ θ,
        |radialPartial Ref (x, θ)| ≤ Mref) :
    let B := prescribedPositiveCollarLower l r δ m κ Lref
    0 < B ∧
      ∀ i : ι,
        let Y := positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate n l r δ v m root (A i) Ref;
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧
        (∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x) ∧
        (∀ (side : Bool) θ, Y (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then v + m else v) ∧
        (∀ k ≤ n + 1, ∀ θ,
          radialBoundaryJet Y (if root then r else l) k θ = A i k θ) ∧
        (∀ side, side ≠ root → ∀ θ, Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)] Ref) := by
  let Mroot : ℝ := M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M
  let Mslope : ℝ := max Mroot Mref
  let L : ℝ := min (κ / 2) Lref
  have hMroot : 0 ≤ Mroot :=
    add_nonneg hM (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hM)
  have hMslope : 0 ≤ Mslope := hMroot.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hL : 0 < L := lt_min (half_pos hκ) hLref
  let P : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i =>
    positiveReferenceCollarField n l r root (A i) Ref
  have hP (i : ι) (side : Bool) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (P i side) := by
    by_cases hs : side = root
    · simp only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_pos hs]
      exact contDiff_boundaryTaylorPolynomial (hA i) _
    · simpa only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_neg hs] using hRef
  have hPvalue (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      P i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then v + m else v := by
    by_cases hs : side = root
    · subst side
      have he := iteratedDeriv_boundaryTaylorPolynomial (n + 1)
        (if root then r else l) (A i) (k := 0) (Nat.zero_le _) θ
      have he' : boundaryTaylorPolynomial (n + 1) (if root then r else l) (A i)
          (if root then r else l, θ) = A i 0 θ := by
        simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using he
      simpa only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_pos rfl, ite_true] using
        he'.trans (hAvalue i θ)
    · simpa only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_neg hs] using hRefValue side hs θ
  have hPbounds (i : ι) (side : Bool) (x : ℝ)
      (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (if side then r else l) δ) (θ : ℝ) :
      L ≤ radialPartial (P i side) (x, θ) ∧
        |radialPartial (P i side) (x, θ)| ≤ Mslope := by
    by_cases hs : side = root
    · subst side
      have hdist : |x - (if root then r else l)| ≤ δ := by
        have hd : |x - (if root then r else l)| < δ := by
          simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using hx
        exact hd.le
      have hb := boundaryTaylorPolynomial_radial_slope_bounds
        hδ.le hδone hM hdist (hAlow i θ) (fun j hj hjn => hAbound i j hj hjn θ) hsmall
      have he : P i root =
          boundaryTaylorPolynomial (n + 1) (if root then r else l) (A i) := by
        simp only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_pos rfl, ite_true]
      rw [he, ← deriv_cylinder_radial_slice
        ((contDiff_boundaryTaylorPolynomial (hA i) _).differentiable (by simp)) x θ]
      exact ⟨(min_le_left _ _).trans hb.1, hb.2.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
    · have hxr : x ∈ Metric.ball (if side then r else l) ρ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball hδρ.le hx
      have he : P i side = Ref := by
        simp only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_neg hs]
      rw [he]
      exact ⟨(min_le_right _ _).trans (hRefLow side hs x hxr θ),
        (hRefBound side hs x hxr θ).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  have hAP (i : ι) (side : Bool) :
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (radialPartial (P i side)) :=
    contDiff_cylinder_radialPartial (hP i side)
  let B : ℝ := m * min (L / m) ((1 / 2) / positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ)
  have hMiddle : 0 < positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ :=
    integral_positiveEndpointCutoff_complement_pos hδ hgap
  have hB : 0 < B :=
    mul_pos hm (lt_min (div_pos hL hm) (div_pos (by norm_num) hMiddle))
  refine ⟨hB, ?_⟩
  intro i
  let Y := positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate n l r δ v m root (A i) Ref
  have hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y :=
    contDiff_parameterizedPositiveReferenceCoordinate (hAP i) l r δ v m
  have hYlow : ∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x :=
    (parameterizedPositiveReferenceCoordinate_uniform_lower
      (hAP i) hδ hgap hm hL hMslope
      (fun side x hx θ => (hPbounds i side x hx θ).1)
      (fun side x hx θ => (hPbounds i side x hx θ).2) hmass v).2
  have hYgerm (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)] P i side :=
    parameterizedPositiveReferenceCoordinate_endpoint_germ
      (hP i) hδ hgap hm.ne' (hPvalue i) side θ
  refine ⟨hY, hYlow, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro side θ
    exact (hYgerm side θ).eq_of_nhds.trans (hPvalue i side θ)
  · intro k hk θ
    have he := iteratedDeriv_parameterizedPositiveReferenceCoordinate_endpoint
      (hP i) hδ hgap hm.ne' (hPvalue i) root θ k
    have hroot : P i root =
        boundaryTaylorPolynomial (n + 1) (if root then r else l) (A i) := by
      simp only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_pos rfl, ite_true]
    rw [hroot] at he
    exact he.trans (iteratedDeriv_boundaryTaylorPolynomial (n + 1)
      (if root then r else l) (A i) hk θ)
  · intro side hs θ
    have he : P i side = Ref := by
      simp only [P, positiveReferenceCollarField, if_neg hs]
    exact (hYgerm side θ).trans (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => congrFun he p)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveReferenceCollarPrescribedWidth
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PrescribedEndpointWidth
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveFiberInterpolationSymmetry
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.TwoEndpointFiberGluing

/-!
# An actual radial fiber from two endpoint jet families

The two endpoint values are their physical radii.  The positive first
normal jets and bounded finite normal jets choose displayed collar widths
before the family index.  The integral construction supplies a genuine
positive radial derivative everywhere and matches the identity between
the two exits as a joint germ.  No determinant condition is needed at the
physical endpoints, so they may be turning radii.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def endpointFiberWidths (n : ℕ) (l r c d κ M : ℝ) (side : Bool) : ℝ :=
  let a := if side then d else l
  let b := if side then r else c
  prescribedEndpointWidth n (b - a) 1 κ M
    (max (M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M) 1) (b - a)

def endpointFiberLower (n : ℕ) (l r c d κ M : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ M
  min (prescribedPositiveCollarLower l c (η false) (c - l) κ 1)
    (min 1 (prescribedPositiveCollarLower d r (η true) (r - d) κ 1))

def endpointFiberCollar (n : ℕ) (l r c d : ℝ) (η : Bool → ℝ)
    (A : Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (side : Bool) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  let a := if side then d else l
  let b := if side then r else c
  positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate n a b (η side) a (b - a) side
    (A side) Prod.fst

def endpointFiberInterpolation (n : ℕ) (l r c d : ℝ) (η : Bool → ℝ)
    (A : Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  twoEndpointFiberCoordinate c d (endpointFiberCollar n l r c d η A) Prod.fst

theorem twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_reference_germ_on_middle
    {Y : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ} {Ref : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c d : ℝ}
    (hcd : c < d)
    (hmatch : ∀ side θ, Y side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then d else c, θ)] Ref)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc c d) (θ : ℝ) :
    twoEndpointFiberCoordinate c d Y Ref =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] Ref := by
  have hright (α : ℝ) : Ref =ᶠ[𝓝 (d, α)] Y true := (hmatch true α).symm
  have hleft (α : ℝ) : Y false =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, α)] radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true) := by
    have hi := radialGermGlue_eventuallyEq hright (c, α)
    change radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true) =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, α)]
      (if c < d then Ref else Y true) at hi
    rw [if_pos hcd] at hi
    exact (hmatch false α).trans hi.symm
  have ho := radialGermGlue_eventuallyEq hleft (x, θ)
  change twoEndpointFiberCoordinate c d Y Ref =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)]
    (if x < c then Y false else radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true)) at ho
  rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_ge hx.1)] at ho
  have hi := radialGermGlue_eventuallyEq hright (x, θ)
  change radialGermGlue d Ref (Y true) =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)]
    (if x < d then Ref else Y true) at hi
  by_cases hxd : x < d
  · rw [if_pos hxd] at hi
    exact ho.trans hi
  · have he : x = d := le_antisymm hx.2 (le_of_not_gt hxd)
    rw [if_neg hxd] at hi
    exact (ho.trans hi).trans (by simpa only [he] using hmatch true θ)

theorem endpointFiberInterpolation_family
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} {A : ι → Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ}
    {l r c d κ M : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hA : ∀ i side j, j ≤ n + 1 → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (A i side j))
    (hvalue : ∀ i side θ, A i side 0 θ = if side then r else l)
    (hlow : ∀ i side θ, κ ≤ A i side 1 θ)
    (hbound : ∀ i side j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ, |A i side j θ| ≤ M)
    (hperiod : ∀ i side j, j ≤ n + 1 → Function.Periodic (A i side j) Real.pi)
    (heven : ∀ i side j, j ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ, A i side j (-θ) = A i side j θ) :
    let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ M
    let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κ M
    (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let Y := endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d η (A i)
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧
      (∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) ∧ (∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet Y (if side then r else l) k θ = A i side k θ := by
  let a : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then d else l
  let b : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then r else c
  let η : Bool → ℝ := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ M
  let Y : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i =>
    endpointFiberCollar n l r c d η (A i)
  let B : Bool → ℝ := fun side =>
    prescribedPositiveCollarLower (a side) (b side) (η side)
      (b side - a side) κ 1
  have hab (side : Bool) : a side < b side := by
    cases side <;> assumption
  have hmarg (side : Bool) := prescribedEndpointWidth_margins n
    (sub_pos.mpr (hab side)) zero_lt_one hκ hM
    (zero_le_one.trans (le_max_right (M + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M) 1))
    (sub_pos.mpr (hab side))
  have hcollar (side : Bool) :
      0 < B side ∧ ∀ i,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y i side) ∧
      (∀ x θ, B side ≤ deriv (fun t => Y i side (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ s θ, Y i side (if s then b side else a side, θ) =
        if s then a side + (b side - a side) else a side) ∧
      (∀ k ≤ n + 1, ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (Y i side) (if side then b side else a side) k θ =
          A i side k θ) ∧
      (∀ s, s ≠ side → ∀ θ,
        Y i side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if s then b side else a side, θ)]
          (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) := by
    apply positiveReferenceCollar_family_of_width side
      (hab side) zero_lt_one hκ hM zero_lt_one zero_le_one (sub_pos.mpr (hab side))
      (hmarg side).1 (hmarg side).2.1 (hmarg side).2.2.1
      (hmarg side).2.2.2.1 (hmarg side).2.2.2.2.1 (hmarg side).2.2.2.2.2
      (fun i j hj => hA i side j hj)
    · intro i θ
      cases side with
      | false => exact hvalue i false θ
      | true =>
        calc
          A i true 0 θ = r := hvalue i true θ
          _ = a true + (b true - a true) := by dsimp only [a, b]; ring
    · exact fun i θ => hlow i side θ
    · exact fun i j hj hjn θ => hbound i side j hj hjn θ
    · exact contDiff_fst
    · intro s hs θ
      cases side <;> cases s <;> simp_all [a, b]
    · intro s hs x hx θ
      exact le_of_eq radialPartial_fst.symm
    · intro s hs x hx θ
      simp only [radialPartial_fst, abs_one, le_refl]
  have hη (side : Bool) : 0 < η side := (hmarg side).1
  have hηgap (side : Bool) : 2 * η side < b side - a side :=
    (hmarg side).2.2.2.1
  have hY (i : ι) (side : Bool) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y i side) :=
    ((hcollar side).2 i).1
  have hYlow (i : ι) (side : Bool) (p : PolarPoint) :
      B side ≤ radialPartial (Y i side) p := by
    have h := ((hcollar side).2 i).2.1 p.1 p.2
    rwa [deriv_cylinder_radial_slice ((hY i side).differentiable (by simp))] at h
  have hmatch (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      Y i side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then d else c, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
    have hs : (!side) ≠ side := by cases side <;> decide
    have h := ((hcollar side).2 i).2.2.2.2 (!side) hs θ
    cases side <;> simpa only [a, b, Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] using h
  have hg (i : ι) := twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_geometry hcd (hY i) contDiff_fst
    (hmatch i) (fun side => (hcollar side).1) zero_lt_one (hYlow i)
    (fun p => le_of_eq radialPartial_fst.symm)
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨hη, hηgap, lt_min (hcollar false).1 (lt_min zero_lt_one (hcollar true).1), ?_⟩
  intro i
  let W := endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d η (A i)
  have hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W := (hg i).1
  have hboundary (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n + 1) (θ : ℝ) :
      radialBoundaryJet W (if side then r else l) k θ = A i side k θ := by
    have he := twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_endpoint_germ hlc hcd hdr (hmatch i) side θ
    have hline : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (x, θ)) (𝓝 (if side then r else l))
        (𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)) :=
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).tendsto _
    have hd := ((he.comp_tendsto hline).iteratedDeriv k).eq_of_nhds
    change radialBoundaryJet W (if side then r else l) k θ =
      radialBoundaryJet (Y i side) (if side then r else l) k θ at hd
    have hj := ((hcollar side).2 i).2.2.2.1 k hk θ
    cases side <;> exact hd.trans hj
  have hsymm (χ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (hInv : ∀ side j, j ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ, A i side j (χ θ) = A i side j θ)
      (x θ : ℝ) : W (x, χ θ) = W (x, θ) := by
    apply twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_angleInvariant c d χ
    · intro side s α
      exact positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate_angleInvariant
        (fun j hj => hA i side j hj) contDiff_fst χ
        (fun j hj β => hInv side j hj β) (fun _ _ => rfl)
        (a side) (b side) (η side) (a side) (b side - a side) side s α
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  refine ⟨hW, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hboundary⟩
  · intro x θ
    rw [deriv_cylinder_radial_slice (hW.differentiable (by simp)) x θ]
    exact (hg i).2.2 (x, θ)
  · intro θ
    simpa only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
      (hboundary false 0 (Nat.zero_le _) θ).trans (hvalue i false θ)
  · intro θ
    simpa only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
      (hboundary true 0 (Nat.zero_le _) θ).trans (hvalue i true θ)
  · exact hsymm (fun θ => θ + Real.pi) (fun side j hj θ => hperiod i side j hj θ)
  · exact hsymm (fun θ => -θ) (fun side j hj θ => heven i side j hj θ)
  · exact fun x hx θ => twoEndpointFiberCoordinate_reference_germ_on_middle hcd
      (hmatch i) hx θ

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.EndpointFiberInterpolation
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.AngularFiberFiniteJetBounds

/-!
# Radial interpolation in the actual angular inverse coordinates

The displayed fiber coordinate uses the true inverse of the chosen
angular lift. A supplied bound on its finite boundary traces determines
the displayed widths. A second theorem obtains that bound from the
ordinary forward jets, uniformly before the family index.
This is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate (n : ℕ) (φ : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (X : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ) (l r c d κ Mσ : ℝ) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d (endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ Mσ)
    (fun side => radialBoundaryJet (angularFiberPullback φ (X side))
      (if side then r else l))

theorem endpointFiberPullback_family_of_bound
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} {φ : ι → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {X : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d κX Mσ : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκX : 0 < κX) (hMσ : 0 ≤ Mσ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i))
    (hX : ∀ i side, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (X i side))
    (hpositive : ∀ i p, 0 < deriv (fun θ => φ i (p.1, θ)) p.2)
    (hφperiod : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, θ + Real.pi) = φ i (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hφodd : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, -θ) = -φ i (x, θ))
    (hXvalue : ∀ i side θ, X i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then r else l)
    (hXlow : ∀ i side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hXperiod : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hXeven : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, -θ) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      |radialBoundaryJet (angularFiberPullback (φ i) (X i side))
        (if side then r else l) k θ| ≤ Mσ) :
    let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ
    let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ
    (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let Y := endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate n (φ i) (X i) l r c d κX Mσ
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧
      (∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) ∧ (∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (fun p => Y (p.1, φ i p)) (if side then r else l) k θ =
          radialBoundaryJet (X i side) (if side then r else l) k θ := by
  let e : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then r else l
  let Z : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i side =>
    angularFiberPullback (φ i) (X i side)
  let A : ι → Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun i side => radialBoundaryJet (Z i side) (e side)
  have hZ (i : ι) (side : Bool) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Z i side) :=
    contDiff_angularFiberPullback Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hX i side)
      (hpositive i) (hφperiod i)
  have hvalue (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) : A i side 0 θ = e side := by
    change iteratedDeriv 0 (fun x => Z i side (x, θ)) (e side) = e side
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using
      angularFiberPullback_boundary (φ := φ i) (hXvalue i side) θ
  have hlow (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) : κX ≤ A i side 1 θ := by
    change κX ≤ iteratedDeriv 1 (fun x => Z i side (x, θ)) (e side)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one,
      deriv_cylinder_radial_slice ((hZ i side).differentiable (by simp)) (e side) θ,
      radialPartial_angularFiberPullback_boundary Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hX i side)
        (hpositive i) (hφperiod i) (hXvalue i side)]
    exact hXlow i side _
  have hperiod (i : ι) (side : Bool) (j : ℕ) :
      Function.Periodic (A i side j) Real.pi := by
    intro θ
    exact radialBoundaryJet_angleInvariant (fun θ => θ + Real.pi)
      (angularFiberPullback_periodic Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hpositive i)
        (hφperiod i) (hXperiod i side)) (e side) j θ
  have heven (i : ι) (side : Bool) (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
      A i side j (-θ) = A i side j θ :=
    radialBoundaryJet_angleInvariant (fun θ => -θ)
      (angularFiberPullback_reflect Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hpositive i)
        (hφperiod i) (hφodd i) (hXeven i side)) (e side) j θ
  have hout := endpointFiberInterpolation_family hlc hcd hdr hκX hMσ
    (fun i side j _ => contDiff_radialBoundaryJet (hZ i side) (e side) j)
    hvalue hlow hbound (fun i side j _ => hperiod i side j)
    (fun i side j _ => heven i side j)
  dsimp only at hout ⊢
  rcases hout with ⟨hη, hηgap, hB, hout⟩
  refine ⟨hη, hηgap, hB, ?_⟩
  intro i
  rcases hout i with ⟨hY, hYlow, hleft, hright, hYperiod, hYeven, hmiddle, hjet⟩
  refine ⟨hY, hYlow, hleft, hright, hYperiod, hYeven, hmiddle, ?_⟩
  intro side
  exact radialBoundaryJets_angularFiber_composition Real.pi_ne_zero
    (hφ i) (hX i side) hY (hpositive i) (hφperiod i) (hjet side)

theorem exists_endpointFiberPullback_family
    {ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) {φ : ι → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {X : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d κφ κX M : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκφ : 0 < κφ) (hκX : 0 < κX) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i))
    (hX : ∀ i side, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (X i side))
    (hφLower : ∀ i x θ, κφ ≤ deriv (fun η => φ i (x, η)) θ)
    (hφperiod : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, θ + Real.pi) = φ i (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hφodd : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, -θ) = -φ i (x, θ))
    (hXvalue : ∀ i side θ, X i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then r else l)
    (hXlow : ∀ i side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hφraw : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hXraw : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hXperiod : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hXeven : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, -θ) = X i side (x, θ)) :
    ∃ Mσ : ℝ, 1 ≤ Mσ ∧
    let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ
    let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ
    (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let Y := endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate n (φ i) (X i) l r c d κX Mσ
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧
      (∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) ∧ (∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (fun p => Y (p.1, φ i p)) (if side then r else l) k θ =
          radialBoundaryJet (X i side) (if side then r else l) k θ := by
  have hpositive (i : ι) (p : PolarPoint) :
      0 < deriv (fun θ => φ i (p.1, θ)) p.2 :=
    hκφ.trans_le (hφLower i p.1 p.2)
  have hangle (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      κφ ≤ angularPartial (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ) := by
    rw [← deriv_cylinder_angular_slice ((hφ i).differentiable (by simp))]
    exact hφLower i _ θ
  have hradial (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      |radialPartial (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)| ≤ M := by
    have hfirst : ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
      simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] using
        hφraw i side 1 le_rfl (by omega) θ
    have hunit :
        |radialPartial (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)| ≤
          ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ := by
      simpa [radialPartial, Prod.norm_def] using
        (fderiv ℝ (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)).le_opNorm (1, 0)
    exact hunit.trans hfirst
  obtain ⟨Mσ, hMσ, hbound⟩ := exists_angularFiberBoundaryJets_bound (n + 1) hκφ hM
  refine ⟨Mσ, hMσ, endpointFiberPullback_family_of_bound hlc hcd hdr
    hκX (zero_le_one.trans hMσ) hφ hX hpositive hφperiod hφodd
    hXvalue hXlow hXperiod hXeven ?_⟩
  intro i side k hk hkn θ
  exact hbound (φ i) (X i side) Real.pi Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hX i side)
    (hpositive i) (hφperiod i) (if side then r else l)
    (hangle i side) (hradial i side) (hφraw i side) (hXraw i side) k hk hkn θ

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Closed geometry and symmetries of positive fiber coordinates

The scalar interpolation supplies positive radial and angular derivatives.
The resulting actual global inverse maps the closed strips as well as the
open strips. Periodicity and reflection are inherited from the two scalar
fields, and their genuine global inverse supplies the boundary inverse germ.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

theorem positiveFiberChart_period_add
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ} {T : ℝ}
    (hφ : ∀ r θ, φ (r, θ + T) = φ (r, θ) + T)
    (hY : ∀ r η, Y (r, η + T) = Y (r, η)) (p : PolarPoint) :
    positiveFiberChart φ Y (p + (0, T)) = positiveFiberChart φ Y p + (0, T) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [positiveFiberChart, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, add_zero, hφ, hY]
  · simp only [positiveFiberChart, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, add_zero, hφ]

theorem positiveFiberChart_reflect
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hφ : ∀ r θ, φ (r, -θ) = -φ (r, θ))
    (hY : ∀ r η, Y (r, -η) = Y (r, η)) (p : PolarPoint) :
    positiveFiberChart φ Y (p.1, -p.2) =
      ((positiveFiberChart φ Y p).1, -(positiveFiberChart φ Y p).2) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [positiveFiberChart, hφ, hY]
  · exact hφ p.1 p.2

/-- Reflection of the inverse follows from the two genuine inverse
identities and reflection of the forward map. -/
theorem inverse_reflect_of_forward_reflect
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    (hleft : Function.LeftInverse G F) (hright : Function.RightInverse G F)
    (hreflect : ∀ p, F (p.1, -p.2) = ((F p).1, -(F p).2))
    (p : PolarPoint) : G (p.1, -p.2) = ((G p).1, -(G p).2) := by
  apply hleft.injective
  rw [hright, hreflect, hright]

/-- The Jacobian of a genuinely reflection-equivariant differentiable
map is even. This uses the actual chain rule twice. -/
theorem planeJacobian_even_of_angle_reflection
    {F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    (hreflect : ∀ p, F (p.1, -p.2) = ((F p).1, -(F p).2))
    (p : PolarPoint) : planeJacobian F (p.1, -p.2) = planeJacobian F p := by
  let R : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := fun q => (q.1, -q.2)
  have hR (q : PolarPoint) : DifferentiableAt ℝ R q :=
    differentiableAt_fst.prodMk differentiableAt_snd.neg
  have hRJ (q : PolarPoint) : planeJacobian R q = -1 := by
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun x : PolarPoint => -x.2)
        (-(ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)) q := hasFDerivAt_snd.fun_neg
    rw [planeJacobian_preserve_first hd.differentiableAt]
    unfold angularPartial
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd']
  have he : F ∘ R = R ∘ F := funext hreflect
  have hj := congrArg (fun H : PolarPoint → PolarPoint => planeJacobian H p) he
  rw [planeJacobian_comp (hR p) (hF (R p)),
    planeJacobian_comp (hF p) (hR (F p)), hRJ p, hRJ (F p)] at hj
  change planeJacobian F (R p) = planeJacobian F p
  linarith only [hj]

/-- The actual global left inverse agrees near the image point with the
smooth local inverse supplied by the ordinary inverse function theorem. -/
theorem canonicalBoundaryInverseGerm_of_global_leftInverse
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F p) (hJ : planeJacobian F p ≠ 0)
    (hleft : Function.LeftInverse G F) : CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm F G p := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hp, hsmooth⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_localInverse_of_planeJacobian_ne_zero hF hJ
  refine ⟨e, he, hp, hsmooth, ?_⟩
  have htarget : F p ∈ e.target := by
    rw [← he]
    exact e.map_source hp
  filter_upwards [e.open_target.mem_nhds htarget] with q hq
  calc
    G q = G (F (e.symm q)) := by
      rw [← he, e.right_inv hq]
    _ = e.symm q := hleft _

/-- The exact endpoint values and the proved radial monotonicity control
both closed-strip maps. No boundary value is assigned to a total inverse. -/
theorem positiveFiberChart_maps_closedStrip
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ} (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y)
    {B l r α β : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B)
    (hYLower : ∀ x η, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, η)) x)
    (hleft : ∀ η, Y (l, η) = α) (hright : ∀ η, Y (r, η) = β) :
    MapsTo (positiveFiberChart φ Y) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
        (Icc α β ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ∧
      MapsTo (positiveFiberChartInverse φ Y) (Icc α β ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
        (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) := by
  have hmono (η : ℝ) : StrictMono (fun x => Y (x, η)) :=
    strictMono_of_deriv_pos (fun x => hB.trans_le (hYLower x η))
  have hR := (positiveFiberRadialInverse_properties hY hB hYLower).2.1
  constructor
  · intro p hp
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, mem_univ _⟩
    · change α ≤ Y (p.1, φ p)
      rw [← hleft (φ p)]
      exact (hmono (φ p)).monotone hp.1.1
    · change Y (p.1, φ p) ≤ β
      rw [← hright (φ p)]
      exact (hmono (φ p)).monotone hp.1.2
  · intro q hq
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, mem_univ _⟩
    · change l ≤ positiveFiberRadialInverse Y q
      by_contra hnot
      have hh := hmono q.2 (lt_of_not_ge hnot)
      rw [hR q, hleft q.2] at hh
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hq.1.1) hh
    · change positiveFiberRadialInverse Y q ≤ r
      by_contra hnot
      have hh := hmono q.2 (lt_of_not_ge hnot)
      rw [hR q, hright q.2] at hh
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hq.1.2) hh

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveFiberClosedGeometry

/-!
# Actual whole-component transport geometry

The two scalar interpolations have positive true derivatives. Their
displayed triangular chart and its displayed inverse therefore supply
all open and closed geometry, symmetries, and genuine middle germs.
This is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure WholeComponentTransportGeometry
    (τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (l r c d J : ℝ) : Prop where
  smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ τ
  inverse_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ
  left_inverse : Function.LeftInverse σ τ
  right_inverse : Function.RightInverse σ τ
  jacobian_lower : ∀ p, J ≤ planeJacobian τ p
  jacobian_positive : ∀ p, 0 < planeJacobian τ p
  bijOn : BijOn τ (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  maps_open : MapsTo τ (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  inverse_maps_open : MapsTo σ
    (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  maps_closed : MapsTo τ (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  inverse_maps_closed : MapsTo σ
    (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  period_add : ∀ p, τ (p + (0, Real.pi)) = τ p + (0, Real.pi)
  inverse_period_add : ∀ p, σ (p + (0, Real.pi)) = σ p + (0, Real.pi)
  reflect : ∀ p, τ (p.1, -p.2) = ((τ p).1, -(τ p).2)
  inverse_reflect : ∀ p, σ (p.1, -p.2) = ((σ p).1, -(σ p).2)
  middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, τ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  inverse_middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ,
    σ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  boundary_inverse : ∀ p, CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm τ σ p

theorem wholeComponentTransportGeometry_of_scalars
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ} {κ B l r c d : ℝ}
    (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hφLower : ∀ x θ, κ ≤ deriv (fun η => φ (x, η)) θ)
    (hYLower : ∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x)
    (hφPeriod : ∀ x θ, φ (x, θ + Real.pi) = φ (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hφOdd : ∀ x θ, φ (x, -θ) = -φ (x, θ))
    (hYPeriod : ∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ))
    (hYEven : ∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ))
    (hleft : ∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) (hright : ∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r)
    (hφMiddle : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ,
      φ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ))
    (hYMiddle : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ,
      Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) :
    WholeComponentTransportGeometry
      (positiveFiberChart φ Y) (positiveFiberChartInverse φ Y) l r c d (B * κ) := by
  let τ := positiveFiberChart φ Y
  let σ := positiveFiberChartInverse φ Y
  obtain ⟨hτ, hσ, hστ, hτσ, hJ⟩ :=
    positiveFiberChart_geometry hφ hY hκ hB Real.pi_ne_zero hφLower hYLower hφPeriod
  have hJpos (p : PolarPoint) : 0 < planeJacobian τ p :=
    (mul_pos hB hκ).trans_le (hJ p)
  have hbij := positiveFiberChart_bijOn_openStrip
    hφ hY hκ hB Real.pi_ne_zero hφLower hYLower hφPeriod hleft hright
  have hclosed := positiveFiberChart_maps_closedStrip hY hB hYLower hleft hright
  have hperiod (p : PolarPoint) : τ (p + (0, Real.pi)) = τ p + (0, Real.pi) :=
    positiveFiberChart_period_add hφPeriod hYPeriod p
  have hreflect (p : PolarPoint) : τ (p.1, -p.2) = ((τ p).1, -(τ p).2) :=
    positiveFiberChart_reflect hφOdd hYEven p
  have hmiddle (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc c d) (θ : ℝ) :
      τ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) := by
    filter_upwards [hφMiddle x hx θ, hYMiddle x hx θ] with p hpφ hpY
    change (Y (p.1, φ p), φ p) = p
    rw [hpφ]
    exact Prod.ext (by simpa only [Prod.eta] using hpY) rfl
  refine {
    smooth := hτ
    inverse_smooth := hσ
    left_inverse := hστ
    right_inverse := hτσ
    jacobian_lower := hJ
    jacobian_positive := hJpos
    bijOn := hbij
    maps_open := hbij.mapsTo
    inverse_maps_open := ?_
    maps_closed := hclosed.1
    inverse_maps_closed := hclosed.2
    period_add := hperiod
    inverse_period_add := ?_
    reflect := hreflect
    inverse_reflect := inverse_reflect_of_forward_reflect hστ hτσ hreflect
    middle_germ := hmiddle
    inverse_middle_germ := ?_
    boundary_inverse := fun p => canonicalBoundaryInverseGerm_of_global_leftInverse
      hτ.contDiffAt (hJpos p).ne' hστ }
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := hbij.surjOn hp
    rw [← heq, hστ]
    exact hq
  · intro p
    apply hστ.injective
    rw [hτσ, hperiod, hτσ]
  · intro x hx θ
    filter_upwards [hmiddle x hx θ] with p hp
    exact (congrArg σ hp.symm).trans (hστ p)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# The displayed whole-component transport and its genuine inverse

Both endpoint fields are matched by the same angular Taylor patch and
the actual radial integral interpolation. Widths and the finite inverse
jet constant precede the family index. This file is a new reconstruction.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def wholeComponentEndpointAngle (n : ℕ) (ψ : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (l r c d κφ M : ℝ) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  positiveAngularTaylorInterpolation (n + 1) l r
    (endpointAngularWidth (n + 1) l r c d κφ M) (rawEndpointAngularData l r ψ)

def wholeComponentEndpointTransport (n : ℕ)
    (ψ X : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ) (l r c d κφ κX M Mσ : ℝ) : PolarPoint → PolarPoint :=
  let φ := wholeComponentEndpointAngle n ψ l r c d κφ M
  positiveFiberChart φ (endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate n φ X l r c d κX Mσ)

def wholeComponentEndpointTransportInverse (n : ℕ)
    (ψ X : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ) (l r c d κφ κX M Mσ : ℝ) : PolarPoint → PolarPoint :=
  let φ := wholeComponentEndpointAngle n ψ l r c d κφ M
  positiveFiberChartInverse φ (endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate n φ X l r c d κX Mσ)

theorem exists_wholeComponentEndpointTransport_family
    {ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) {ψ X : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {l r c d κφ κX M : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκφ : 0 < κφ) (hκφone : κφ ≤ 1) (hκX : 0 < κX) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hψ : ∀ i side, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ψ i side))
    (hψangle : ∀ i side θ, κφ ≤ angularPartial (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hψjets : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 2 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hψperiod : ∀ i side x θ, ψ i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = ψ i side (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hψodd : ∀ i side x θ, ψ i side (x, -θ) = -ψ i side (x, θ))
    (hX : ∀ i side, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (X i side))
    (hXvalue : ∀ i side θ, X i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then r else l)
    (hXlow : ∀ i side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hXjets : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hXperiod : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hXeven : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, -θ) = X i side (x, θ)) :
    let δ := endpointAngularWidth (n + 1) l r c d κφ M
    0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧ 2 * δ < r - l ∧ δ < c - l ∧ δ < r - d ∧
      ∃ Mσ : ℝ, 1 ≤ Mσ ∧
      let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ
      let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ
      (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let τ := wholeComponentEndpointTransport n (ψ i) (X i) l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let σ := wholeComponentEndpointTransportInverse n (ψ i) (X i) l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      WholeComponentTransportGeometry τ σ l r c d (B * (κφ / 2)) ∧
      (∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (fun p => (τ p).1) (if side then r else l) k θ =
          radialBoundaryJet (X i side) (if side then r else l) k θ) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (fun p => (τ p).2) (if side then r else l) k θ =
          radialBoundaryJet (ψ i side) (if side then r else l) k θ := by
  have hang := rawEndpointAngularInterpolation_family (n + 1) hlc hcd hdr
    hκφ hκφone hM hψ hψangle hψjets hψperiod hψodd
  dsimp only at hang ⊢
  rcases hang with ⟨hδ, hδone, hδgap, hδL, hδR, hang⟩
  let φ : ι → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i =>
    wholeComponentEndpointAngle n (ψ i) l r c d κφ M
  have hφ (i : ι) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i) := (hang i).1
  have hφlower (i : ι) (x θ : ℝ) :
      κφ / 2 ≤ deriv (fun η => φ i (x, η)) θ := (hang i).2.1 x θ
  have hφperiod (i : ι) (x θ : ℝ) :
      φ i (x, θ + Real.pi) = φ i (x, θ) + Real.pi := (hang i).2.2.2.2.1 x θ
  have hφodd (i : ι) (x θ : ℝ) :
      φ i (x, -θ) = -φ i (x, θ) := (hang i).2.2.2.2.2.1 x θ
  have hφraw (i : ι) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
      (hkn : k ≤ n + 1) (θ : ℝ) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
    rw [(hang i).2.2.2.1 side k hkn θ]
    exact hψjets i side k hk (by omega) θ
  obtain ⟨Mσ, hMσ, hη, hηgap, hB, hfiber⟩ :=
    exists_endpointFiberPullback_family n hlc hcd hdr (half_pos hκφ) hκX hM
      hφ hX hφlower hφperiod hφodd hXvalue hXlow hφraw hXjets hXperiod hXeven
  refine ⟨hδ, hδone, hδgap, hδL, hδR, Mσ, hMσ, hη, hηgap, hB, ?_⟩
  intro i
  rcases hfiber i with ⟨hY, hYlower, hleft, hright, hYperiod, hYeven, hYmiddle, hYjets⟩
  refine ⟨wholeComponentTransportGeometry_of_scalars (hφ i) hY
    (half_pos hκφ) hB (hφlower i) hYlower (hφperiod i) (hφodd i)
    hYperiod hYeven hleft hright ((hang i).2.2.2.2.2.2) hYmiddle,
    hYjets, (hang i).2.2.1⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.OneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.WholeComponentTransportFactory

/-!
# Whole-component transport from genuine one-sided endpoint fields

The raw fields need only be smooth on their own physical strip and at its
root circle. Their displayed finite Taylor representatives supply the
global fields used by the integral interpolation. Every finite input
bound is preserved exactly. The resulting transport matches the full
ordinary boundary jets of the original fields, on either physical side.
An ambient endpoint is allowed to supply the identity fields.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n : ℕ) (l r : ℝ)
    (F : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ) (side : Bool) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative n (if side then r else l) (F side)

def oneSidedWholeComponentTransport (n : ℕ)
    (ψ X : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ) (l r c d κφ κX M Mσ : ℝ) : PolarPoint → PolarPoint :=
  wholeComponentEndpointTransport n (oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 2) l r ψ)
    (oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 1) l r X) l r c d κφ κX M Mσ

def oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse (n : ℕ)
    (ψ X : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ) (l r c d κφ κX M Mσ : ℝ) : PolarPoint → PolarPoint :=
  wholeComponentEndpointTransportInverse n (oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 2) l r ψ)
    (oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 1) l r X) l r c d κφ κX M Mσ

private theorem endpointRepresentative_fderiv_eq
    {F : PolarPoint → ℝ} {a b x : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) (hFx : ∀ θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F (x, θ))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (θ : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative n x F) (x, θ) =
      fderiv ℝ F (x, θ) := by
  have he := iteratedFDeriv_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative hab hF hx hFx n hn θ
  ext v
  simpa only [iteratedFDeriv_one_apply] using
    congrArg (fun T : PolarPoint [×1]→L[ℝ] ℝ => T (fun _ => v)) he

theorem exists_oneSidedWholeComponentTransport_family
    {ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) {ψ X : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {a b : Bool → ℝ} {l r c d κφ κX M : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hab : ∀ side, a side < b side)
    (hend : ∀ side, (if side then r else l) ∈ Icc (a side) (b side))
    (hκφ : 0 < κφ) (hκφone : κφ ≤ 1) (hκX : 0 < κX) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hψ : ∀ i side, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ i side)
      (Ioo (a side) (b side) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hψroot : ∀ i side θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hψangle : ∀ i side θ, κφ ≤ angularPartial (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hψjets : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 2 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hψperiod : ∀ i side x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      ψ i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = ψ i side (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hψodd : ∀ i side x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      ψ i side (x, -θ) = -ψ i side (x, θ))
    (hX : ∀ i side, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (X i side)
      (Ioo (a side) (b side) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hXroot : ∀ i side θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hXvalue : ∀ i side θ, X i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then r else l)
    (hXlow : ∀ i side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hXjets : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hXperiod : ∀ i side x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      X i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hXeven : ∀ i side x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      X i side (x, -θ) = X i side (x, θ)) :
    let δ := endpointAngularWidth (n + 1) l r c d κφ M
    0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧ 2 * δ < r - l ∧ δ < c - l ∧ δ < r - d ∧
      ∃ Mσ : ℝ, 1 ≤ Mσ ∧
      let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ
      let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ
      (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let τ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransport n (ψ i) (X i) l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let σ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse n (ψ i) (X i) l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      WholeComponentTransportGeometry τ σ l r c d (B * (κφ / 2)) ∧
      (∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p => (τ p).1) (if side then r else l, θ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ)) ∧
      (∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p => (τ p).2) (if side then r else l, θ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ)) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k τ (if side then r else l, θ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p => (X i side p, ψ i side p))
            (if side then r else l, θ) := by
  let Ψ : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i =>
    oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 2) l r (ψ i)
  let Y : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i =>
    oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 1) l r (X i)
  have hΨ (i : ι) (side : Bool) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Ψ i side) :=
    contDiff_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative _ (hψroot i side) _
  have hY (i : ι) (side : Bool) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y i side) :=
    contDiff_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative _ (hXroot i side) _
  have hΨangle (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      κφ ≤ angularPartial (Ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ) := by
    dsimp only [Ψ, oneSidedEndpointRepresentative]
    unfold angularPartial
    rw [endpointRepresentative_fderiv_eq (hab side) (hψ i side)
      (hend side) (hψroot i side) (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 2)]
    exact hψangle i side θ
  have hYlow (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      κX ≤ radialPartial (Y i side) (if side then r else l, θ) := by
    dsimp only [Y, oneSidedEndpointRepresentative]
    unfold radialPartial
    rw [endpointRepresentative_fderiv_eq (hab side) (hX i side)
      (hend side) (hXroot i side) (by omega : 1 ≤ n + 1)]
    exact hXlow i side θ
  have hΨjets (i : ι) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n + 2) (θ : ℝ) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (Ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
    dsimp only [Ψ, oneSidedEndpointRepresentative]
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
      (hab side) (hψ i side) (hend side) (hψroot i side) (n + 2) hkn]
    exact hψjets i side k hk hkn θ
  have hYjets (i : ι) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n + 1) (θ : ℝ) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (Y i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
    dsimp only [Y, oneSidedEndpointRepresentative]
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
      (hab side) (hX i side) (hend side) (hXroot i side) (n + 1) hkn]
    exact hXjets i side k hk hkn θ
  have hYvalue (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      Y i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then r else l := by
    have he := radialBoundaryJet_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
      (X i side) (n + 1) (if side then r else l) (Nat.zero_le _) θ
    dsimp only [Y, oneSidedEndpointRepresentative]
    simpa only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero, hXvalue i side θ] using he
  have hout := exists_wholeComponentEndpointTransport_family n hlc hcd hdr
    hκφ hκφone hκX hM hΨ hΨangle hΨjets
    (fun i side => oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_lift
      (hab side) (hend side) (hψroot i side) (hψperiod i side) (n + 2))
    (fun i side => oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_odd
      (hab side) (hend side) (hψroot i side) (hψodd i side) (n + 2))
    hY hYvalue hYlow hYjets
    (fun i side => oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_angleInvariant
      (hab side) (hend side) (hXroot i side) (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      (hXperiod i side) (n + 1))
    (fun i side => oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_angleInvariant
      (hab side) (hend side) (hXroot i side) contDiff_id.neg
      (hXeven i side) (n + 1))
  dsimp only at hout ⊢
  rcases hout with ⟨hδ, hδone, hδgap, hδL, hδR, Mσ, hMσ, hη, hηgap, hB, hout⟩
  refine ⟨hδ, hδone, hδgap, hδL, hδR, Mσ, hMσ, hη, hηgap, hB, ?_⟩
  intro i
  rcases hout i with ⟨hgeometry, hradial, hangular⟩
  let τ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransport n (ψ i) (X i) l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
  have hτ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ τ := hgeometry.smooth
  have hfirst (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n + 1) (θ : ℝ) :
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p => (τ p).1) (if side then r else l, θ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ) := by
    apply iteratedFDeriv_eq_of_radialBoundaryJets_eq_on_closedStrip
      (hab side) hτ.fst.contDiffOn (hX i side) (hend side)
      (fun _ => hτ.fst.contDiffAt) (hXroot i side) (N := n + 1) _ hk θ
    intro j hj η
    exact (hradial side j hj η).trans
      (radialBoundaryJet_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
        (X i side) (n + 1) _ hj η)
  have hsecond (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n + 1) (θ : ℝ) :
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p => (τ p).2) (if side then r else l, θ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ) := by
    apply iteratedFDeriv_eq_of_radialBoundaryJets_eq_on_closedStrip
      (hab side) hτ.snd.contDiffOn (hψ i side) (hend side)
      (fun _ => hτ.snd.contDiffAt) (hψroot i side) (N := n + 1) _ hk θ
    intro j hj η
    exact (hangular side j hj η).trans
      (radialBoundaryJet_oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
        (ψ i side) (n + 2) _ (by omega) η)
  refine ⟨hgeometry, hfirst, hsecond, ?_⟩
  intro side k hk θ
  have hτpair : τ = fun p => ((τ p).1, (τ p).2) :=
    funext (fun p => (Prod.eta (τ p)).symm)
  conv_lhs => rw [hτpair]
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_prodMk hτ.fst.contDiffAt hτ.snd.contDiffAt
      (by simp : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞),
    iteratedFDeriv_prodMk (hXroot i side θ) (hψroot i side θ)
      (by simp : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞), hfirst side k hk θ, hsecond side k hk θ]

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.OneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveHeightTaylorInterpolation

/-!
# Reference identities for the actual radial Taylor data

A genuine joint identity germ determines every radial trace. The
displayed finite polynomials therefore reproduce the two projections,
and a unit height germ makes the logarithmic interpolation exactly one.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ
    {F G : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ θ, F =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, θ)] G) (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    radialBoundaryJet F c j θ = radialBoundaryJet G c j θ := by
  have hline : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (x, θ)) (𝓝 c) (𝓝 (c, θ)) :=
    (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).tendsto c
  exact ((h θ).comp_tendsto hline).iteratedDeriv_eq j

theorem boundaryTaylorPolynomial_snd (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    boundaryTaylorPolynomial n c (radialBoundaryJet (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) c) =
      (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  funext p
  unfold boundaryTaylorPolynomial
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one,
      div_one, pow_zero, mul_one]
  · intro j _ hj
    simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_const, if_neg hj, zero_div, zero_mul]
  · intro hzero
    exact (hzero (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n))).elim

theorem boundaryTaylorPolynomial_fst (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    boundaryTaylorPolynomial (n + 1) c (radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) c) =
      (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  funext p
  have hterm (j : ℕ) :
      radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) c j p.2 /
          (j.factorial : ℝ) * (p.1 - c) ^ j =
        (if j = 0 then c else 0) + (if j = 1 then p.1 - c else 0) := by
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one,
        div_one, pow_zero, mul_one, if_pos rfl, Nat.zero_ne_one, ite_false, add_zero]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_fun_id, Nat.factorial_one,
          Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_one, one_mul, Nat.one_ne_zero, ite_false, if_pos rfl,
          zero_add]
      · simp only [radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_fun_id, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1,
          zero_div, zero_mul, zero_add]
  have hzero : 0 ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  have hone : 1 ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  simp only [boundaryTaylorPolynomial, hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', hzero, hone, ite_true]
  ring

theorem oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_eq_snd
    {F : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ θ, F =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, θ)] (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative n c F = (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  have he : radialBoundaryJet F c = radialBoundaryJet (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) c := by
    funext j θ
    exact radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ h j θ
  rw [oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative, he, boundaryTaylorPolynomial_snd]

theorem oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_eq_fst
    {F : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ θ, F =ᶠ[𝓝 (c, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative (n + 1) c F = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  have he : radialBoundaryJet F c = radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) c := by
    funext j θ
    exact radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ h j θ
  rw [oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative, he, boundaryTaylorPolynomial_fst]

theorem positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_reference_one
    (n : ℕ) (l r δ : ℝ) {h : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hOne : ∀ side θ, h side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) :
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hzero (side : Bool) (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
      positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) h side j θ = 0 := by
    have hlog : ∀ η, boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h side) =ᶠ[
        𝓝 (if side then r else l, η)] (fun _ : PolarPoint => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro η
      filter_upwards [hOne side η] with p hp
      simp only [boundaryHeightLogRatio, hp, div_one, Real.log_one]
    have he := radialBoundaryJet_eq_of_joint_germ hlog j θ
    simpa only [positiveHeightTaylorData, radialBoundaryJet,
      iteratedDeriv_fun_const_zero] using he
  funext p
  simp only [positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation, endpointTaylorCorrection,
    boundaryTaylorPolynomial, hzero, zero_div, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveReferenceCollarPrescribedWidth

/-!
# The fixed identity and a numerical lower bound for the same primitive

Constant physical endpoint slopes with total mass `r - l` produce the
identity radial coordinate. The unused middle mass is at most that
width, so the prescribed lower bound has a width-independent floor.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements

private theorem positiveReferenceScale_constant_unit_mass
    {l r δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hgap : 2 * δ < r - l) :
    positiveReferenceScale l r δ (fun _ => 1 / (r - l))
      (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) = 1 / (r - l) := by
  have hm : 0 < r - l := by linarith
  have hMiddle : 0 < positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ :=
    integral_positiveEndpointCutoff_complement_pos hδ hgap
  have hL := (contDiff_positiveEndpointCutoff l δ).continuous
  have hR := (contDiff_positiveEndpointCutoff r δ).continuous
  have hEnds : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
      positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x * (1 / (r - l)) +
        positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x * (1 / (r - l))) :=
    (hL.mul continuous_const).add (hR.mul continuous_const)
  have hMiddleScaled : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
      (1 / (r - l)) *
        (1 - positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x - positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x)) :=
    continuous_const.mul ((continuous_const.sub hL).sub hR)
  have hmass : positiveReferenceEndMass l r δ
      (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) +
      (1 / (r - l)) * positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ = 1 := by
    change (∫ x in l..r,
        positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x * (1 / (r - l)) +
          positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x * (1 / (r - l))) +
        (1 / (r - l)) * (∫ x in l..r,
          1 - positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x - positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x) = 1
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_add
        (hEnds.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) l r)
        (hMiddleScaled.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) l r)]
    calc
      _ = ∫ _x in l..r, (1 / (r - l)) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro x _
        ring
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp [hm.ne']
  unfold positiveReferenceScale
  apply (div_eq_iff hMiddle.ne').mpr
  linarith only [hmass]

/-- With unit physical endpoint slopes, the actual primitive is the
identity on the whole plane, including both exterior portions. -/
theorem parameterizedPositiveReferenceCoordinate_one_eq_fst
    {l r δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hgap : 2 * δ < r - l) :
    parameterizedPositiveReferenceCoordinate l r δ l (r - l)
      (fun _ _ => 1) = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  have hm : 0 < r - l := by linarith
  have hscale := positiveReferenceScale_constant_unit_mass hδ hgap
  have hs : positiveReferenceSlope l r δ
      (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) =
      (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) := by
    funext x
    simp only [positiveReferenceSlope, hscale]
    ring
  funext p
  change l + (r - l) * (∫ x in l..p.1,
    positiveReferenceSlope l r δ
      (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) (fun _ => 1 / (r - l)) x) = p.1
  rw [hs, intervalIntegral.integral_const]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp [hm.ne'] <;> ring

/-- The positive middle cutoff never contributes more than the width. -/
theorem positiveReferenceMiddleMass_le_width
    {l r δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hgap : 2 * δ < r - l) :
    positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ ≤ r - l := by
  have hm : 0 < r - l := by linarith
  have hb (x : ℝ) :
      ‖1 - positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x - positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have hL := positiveEndpointCutoff_nonneg l δ x
    have hR := positiveEndpointCutoff_nonneg r δ x
    have hsum := positiveEndpointCutoff_add_le_one hδ hgap.le x
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x -
        positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x := by linarith
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
    linarith
  have hn := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := l) (b := r) (C := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun x => 1 - positiveEndpointCutoff l δ x - positiveEndpointCutoff r δ x)
    (fun x _ => hb x)
  have hn' : |positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ| ≤ r - l := by
    simpa only [positiveReferenceMiddleMass, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hm, one_mul] using hn
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans hn'

/-- The reference slope is one and its fixed mass is the component width. -/
theorem prescribedPositiveCollarLower_reference_lower
    {l r δ κ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hgap : 2 * δ < r - l) :
    min (κ / 2) (1 / 2) ≤
      prescribedPositiveCollarLower l r δ (r - l) κ 1 := by
  have hm : 0 < r - l := by linarith
  have hMiddle : 0 < positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ :=
    integral_positiveEndpointCutoff_complement_pos hδ hgap
  have hupper := positiveReferenceMiddleMass_le_width hδ hgap
  let k : ℝ := min (κ / 2) (1 / 2)
  have hL : k ≤ min (κ / 2) (1 : ℝ) :=
    le_min (min_le_left _ _)
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1))
  have hR : k / (r - l) ≤ (1 / 2) / positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ :=
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) hm.le).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) hMiddle hupper)
  have hbound : k ≤
      min (min (κ / 2) 1 / (r - l))
        ((1 / 2) / positiveReferenceMiddleMass l r δ) * (r - l) :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hm).mp
      (le_min (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hL hm.le) hR)
  simpa only [k, prescribedPositiveCollarLower, mul_comm] using hbound

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis
