/-!
# Exact reference identity of the displayed whole-component transport

The reference germs determine the actual finite Taylor representatives.
Their radial integral has unit physical slope and its prescribed mass
is the interval width. Both pointwise inverses are consequently the
identity as well. No estimate on an unspecified transport is assumed.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate_reference_identity
    (n : ℕ) {a b δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hgap : 2 * δ < b - a) (root : Bool) :
    positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate n a b δ a (b - a) root
      (radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) (if root then b else a))
      Prod.fst = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  have hfield : positiveReferenceCollarField n a b root
      (radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) (if root then b else a))
      Prod.fst = (fun _ => (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) := by
    funext side
    by_cases he : side = root
    · subst side
      simp only [positiveReferenceCollarField, if_pos rfl, boundaryTaylorPolynomial_fst]
    · simp only [positiveReferenceCollarField, if_neg he]
  have hslope : (fun side => radialPartial (positiveReferenceCollarField n a b root
      (radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) (if root then b else a))
      Prod.fst side)) = (fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hfield]
    funext side p
    exact radialPartial_fst
  rw [positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate, hslope]
  exact parameterizedPositiveReferenceCoordinate_one_eq_fst hδ hgap

theorem endpointFiberInterpolation_reference_identity
    (n : ℕ) {l r c d : ℝ} {η : Bool → ℝ}
    (hη : ∀ side, 0 < η side)
    (hgap : ∀ side, 2 * η side <
      (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) :
    endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d η
      (fun side => radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)
        (if side then r else l)) = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
  have hcollar (side : Bool) : endpointFiberCollar n l r c d η
      (fun t => radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)
        (if t then r else l)) side = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
    cases side with
    | false => exact positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate_reference_identity n
        (hη false) (hgap false) false
    | true => exact positiveReferenceCollarCoordinate_reference_identity n
        (hη true) (hgap true) true
  funext p
  simp only [endpointFiberInterpolation, twoEndpointFiberCoordinate, hcollar,
    radialGermGlue, ite_self]

theorem positiveFiberChartInverse_projections :
    positiveFiberChartInverse (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) Prod.fst =
      (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) := by
  funext p
  apply Prod.ext
  · change Function.invFun (id : ℝ → ℝ) p.1 = p.1
    exact Function.leftInverse_invFun Function.injective_id p.1
  · change Function.invFun (id : ℝ → ℝ) p.2 = p.2
    exact Function.leftInverse_invFun Function.injective_id p.2

theorem wholeComponentEndpointTransport_reference_identity
    (n : ℕ) {l r c d κφ κX M Mσ : ℝ}
    (hη : ∀ side, 0 < endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ side)
    (hgap : ∀ side, 2 * endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ side <
      (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) :
    wholeComponentEndpointTransport n (fun _ => Prod.snd) (fun _ => Prod.fst)
      l r c d κφ κX M Mσ = id ∧
    wholeComponentEndpointTransportInverse n (fun _ => Prod.snd) (fun _ => Prod.fst)
      l r c d κφ κX M Mσ = id := by
  have hangle : wholeComponentEndpointAngle n (fun _ => Prod.snd)
      l r c d κφ M = (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
    funext p
    simp only [wholeComponentEndpointAngle, rawEndpointAngularData,
      positiveAngularTaylorInterpolation, positiveAngularTaylorPatch,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true, boundaryTaylorPolynomial_snd]
    ring
  have hY : endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate n (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ)
      (fun _ => Prod.fst) l r c d κX Mσ = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
    change endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d (endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ)
      (fun side => radialBoundaryJet (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)
        (if side then r else l)) = (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    exact endpointFiberInterpolation_reference_identity n hη hgap
  simp only [wholeComponentEndpointTransport, wholeComponentEndpointTransportInverse,
    hangle, hY]
  exact ⟨funext (fun p => Prod.eta p), positiveFiberChartInverse_projections⟩

theorem oneSidedWholeComponentTransport_reference_identity
    (n : ℕ) {ψ X : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d κφ κX M Mσ : ℝ}
    (hψ : ∀ side θ, ψ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)]
      (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ))
    (hX : ∀ side θ, X side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)]
      (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ))
    (hη : ∀ side, 0 < endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ side)
    (hgap : ∀ side, 2 * endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ side <
      (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) :
    oneSidedWholeComponentTransport n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ = id ∧
    oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ = id := by
  have hψrep : oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 2) l r ψ =
      (fun _ => (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ)) := by
    funext side
    exact oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_eq_snd (hψ side) (n + 2)
  have hXrep : oneSidedEndpointRepresentative (n + 1) l r X =
      (fun _ => (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) := by
    funext side
    exact oneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative_eq_fst (hX side) n
  simpa only [oneSidedWholeComponentTransport, oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse,
    hψrep, hXrep] using
    (wholeComponentEndpointTransport_reference_identity
      (κφ := κφ) (M := M) n hη hgap)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.OneHighCompositionJets
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.ZPow
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv

/-!
# Fixed polynomial bounds for the actual logarithm jets

The coefficient is chosen before the numerical envelope and the field.
The positive value, its reciprocal, and the finite positive-order jets
are the only inputs. The zeroth logarithm is included without assuming
a bound on a real angular lift or on any constructed coordinate field.
This is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Real
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff

private theorem log_successor_jet_norm (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) Real.log x‖ =
      (j.factorial : ℝ) * |x⁻¹| ^ (j + 1) := by
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_succ',
    Real.deriv_log', iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, iter_deriv_inv]
  have he : (-1 - (j : ℤ)) = -((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← inv_pow]
  simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_one,
    one_pow, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg j.factorial)]

private theorem log_positive_jet_bound {H x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hInv : x⁻¹ ≤ H) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Real.log x‖ ≤
      ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ k := by
  have he : k - 1 + 1 = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
  have hn := log_successor_jet_norm (k - 1) x
  rw [he, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hx)] at hn
  rw [hn]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr hx.le) hInv k) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

private theorem log_value_bound {H x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hVal : x ≤ H) (hInv : x⁻¹ ≤ H) : |Real.log x| ≤ H := by
  have hp := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx
  have hm := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hx)
  rw [Real.log_inv] at hm
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith only [hm, hInv], by linarith only [hp, hVal]⟩

private def logJetCoefficient (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ π : OrderedFinpartition k, ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ)

private theorem logJetCoefficient_nonneg (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ logJetCoefficient k :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- All constants precede the numerical envelope, the point, and the
actual field. The exponent is displayed uniformly through order `N`. -/
theorem exists_log_finiteJet_polynomial_envelope
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ {H : ℝ}, 1 ≤ H → ∀ (f : E → ℝ) (x : E),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x → 0 < f x → f x ≤ H → (f x)⁻¹ ≤ H →
      (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x‖ ≤ H) →
      ∀ k, k ≤ N →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Real.log (f y)) x‖ ≤ C * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
  classical
  let C : ℝ := 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), logJetCoefficient j
  have hC : 1 ≤ C := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), logJetCoefficient j :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => logJetCoefficient_nonneg j
    dsimp only [C]
    linarith only [hp]
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro H hH f x hf hx hVal hInv hraw k hk
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := zero_le_one.trans hH
  have hpow0 : 0 ≤ H ^ (2 * N + 1) := pow_nonneg hH0 _
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · subst k
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      |Real.log (f x)| ≤ H := log_value_bound hx hVal hInv
      _ ≤ H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
        simpa only [pow_one] using pow_le_pow_right₀ hH (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * N + 1)
      _ ≤ C * H ^ (2 * N + 1) :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_left hpow0 hC
  have hpositive : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0
  have hcomp := norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le_partition_sum
    (Real.contDiffAt_log.mpr hx.ne') hf k
  have hterm (π : OrderedFinpartition k) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ π.length Real.log (f x)‖ *
          ∏ j, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (π.partSize j) f x‖ ≤
        ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
    have hout := log_positive_jet_bound hx hInv (π.length_pos hpositive)
    have hprod : (∏ j, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (π.partSize j) f x‖) ≤ H ^ π.length := by
      simpa only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
        (Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
          (fun j _ => hraw (π.partSize j) (π.partSize_pos j)
            ((π.partSize_le j).trans hk)))
    calc
      _ ≤ (((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ π.length) * H ^ π.length :=
        mul_le_mul hout hprod (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hH0 _))
      _ = ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ (2 * π.length) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
        congr 2
        omega
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (pow_le_pow_right₀ hH (by have hp := π.length_le; omega)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hcoeff : logJetCoefficient k ≤ C := by
    have hm : k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => logJetCoefficient_nonneg j) hm).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ π : OrderedFinpartition k,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ π.length Real.log (f x)‖ *
          ∏ j, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (π.partSize j) f x‖ := hcomp
    _ ≤ ∑ π : OrderedFinpartition k,
        ((π.length - 1).factorial : ℝ) * H ^ (2 * N + 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun π _ => hterm π
    _ = logJetCoefficient k * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      rfl
    _ ≤ C * H ^ (2 * N + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff hpow0

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveHeightTaylorInterpolation
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.AngularTaylorPolynomial

/-!
# Value bounds for the actual logarithmic height interpolation

A collar small enough for the positive Taylor orders keeps each
logarithmic polynomial within one of its boundary value. Bounds for
the given height and its reciprocal therefore yield a polynomial
amplitude bound for the constructed height and its reciprocal.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_one_germ
    (n : ℕ) {l r δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (h : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (p : PolarPoint) (hL : p.1 ∉ Metric.ball l δ) (hR : p.1 ∉ Metric.ball r δ) :
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h =ᶠ[𝓝 p]
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hleft := (positiveEndpointCutoff_zero_germ_of_not_mem_ball hδ hL).comp_tendsto
    (continuous_fst.continuousAt (x := p))
  have hright := (positiveEndpointCutoff_zero_germ_of_not_mem_ball hδ hR).comp_tendsto
    (continuous_fst.continuousAt (x := p))
  filter_upwards [hleft, hright] with y hyL hyR
  have hyL' : positiveEndpointCutoff l δ y.1 = 0 := hyL
  have hyR' : positiveEndpointCutoff r δ y.1 = 0 := hyR
  simp only [positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation, endpointTaylorCorrection,
    hyL', hyR', zero_mul, zero_add, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]

theorem positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_amplitude
    (n : ℕ) {l r δ M H : ℝ} {h : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδone : δ ≤ 1) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hpositive : ∀ side θ, 0 < h side (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hupper : ∀ side θ, h side (if side then r else l, θ) ≤ H)
    (hinverse : ∀ side θ, (h side (if side then r else l, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H)
    (hlog : ∀ side j, 0 < j → j ≤ n → ∀ θ,
      |positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) h side j θ| ≤ M)
    (hsmall : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * δ ≤ 1) (p : PolarPoint) :
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h p ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 ∧
      (positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) h p)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 := by
  let A := positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) h
  let e : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then r else l
  have hHpos : 0 < H := zero_lt_one.trans_le hH
  have hlogH : 0 ≤ Real.log H := Real.log_nonneg hH
  have hA0 (side : Bool) : |A side 0 p.2| ≤ Real.log H := by
    have hu := Real.log_le_log (hpositive side p.2) (hupper side p.2)
    have hi := Real.log_le_log (inv_pos.mpr (hpositive side p.2)) (hinverse side p.2)
    rw [Real.log_inv] at hi
    change |Real.log (h side (e side, p.2) / 1)| ≤ Real.log H
    rw [div_one]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hu⟩
  have hterm (side : Bool) :
      |positiveEndpointCutoff (e side) δ p.1 *
        boundaryTaylorPolynomial n (e side) (A side) p| ≤ Real.log H + 1 := by
    apply abs_positiveEndpointCutoff_mul_le
      (f := fun x => boundaryTaylorPolynomial n (e side) (A side) (x, p.2))
      hδ (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log H + 1)
    intro x hx
    have hx' : |x - e side| ≤ δ := by
      exact (show |x - e side| < δ from (by
        simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using hx)).le
    have hd := (abs_boundaryTaylorPolynomial_sub_zero_le
      hδ.le hδone hM hx' (fun j hj hjn => hlog side j hj hjn p.2)).trans hsmall
    have ht := abs_add
      (boundaryTaylorPolynomial n (e side) (A side) (x, p.2) - A side 0 p.2) (A side 0 p.2)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at ht
    linarith only [ht, hd, hA0 side]
  have hE : |endpointTaylorCorrection n l r δ A p| ≤ 2 * (Real.log H + 1) := by
    have hleft := hterm false
    have hright := hterm true
    change |positiveEndpointCutoff l δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n l (A false) p +
      positiveEndpointCutoff r δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n r (A true) p| ≤ _
    exact (abs_add _ _).trans (by
      change |positiveEndpointCutoff l δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n l (A false) p| +
        |positiveEndpointCutoff r δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n r (A true) p| ≤ _
      change |positiveEndpointCutoff l δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n l (A false) p| ≤ _ at hleft
      change |positiveEndpointCutoff r δ p.1 * boundaryTaylorPolynomial n r (A true) p| ≤ _ at hright
      linarith)
  have hexp : Real.exp (2 * (Real.log H + 1)) = Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 := by
    rw [show 2 * (Real.log H + 1) = 2 + (Real.log H + Real.log H) by ring,
      Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hHpos]
    ring
  simp only [positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation, one_mul]
  change Real.exp (endpointTaylorCorrection n l r δ A p) ≤ _ ∧
    (Real.exp (endpointTaylorCorrection n l r δ A p))⁻¹ ≤ _
  constructor
  · exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans hE)).trans_eq hexp
  · rw [← Real.exp_neg]
    exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((neg_le_abs _).trans hE)).trans_eq hexp

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.OneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.EndpointHeightValueBounds

/-!
# One common explicit collar for genuine one-sided height fields

The radius is the reciprocal of a displayed sum. Its inverse cost is
therefore exact, and its choice precedes the family index. Finite
ordinary jets match the actual one-sided field at both root circles.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth (n : ℕ) (ρ M : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M + 1))⁻¹

theorem oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth_margins (n : ℕ) {ρ M : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    let δ := oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth n ρ M
    0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
      δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M + 1) ∧
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * δ ≤ 1 := by
  let N : ℝ := ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let D : ℝ := ρ⁻¹ + 1 + N * (M + 1)
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    change (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
  have hρinv : 0 < ρ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hρ
  have hprod : 0 ≤ N * (M + 1) := mul_nonneg hN.le (by linarith)
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp only [D]; positivity
  have hDρ : ρ⁻¹ ≤ D := by dsimp only [D]; linarith only [hprod]
  have hDone : 1 ≤ D := by dsimp only [D]; linarith only [hρinv, hprod]
  have hδρ : D⁻¹ ≤ ρ := by
    simpa only [inv_inv] using (inv_le_inv₀ hD hρinv).mpr hDρ
  have hδone : D⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [inv_one] using (inv_le_inv₀ hD zero_lt_one).mpr hDone
  have hNM : N * M ≤ D := by dsimp only [D]; nlinarith only [hN, hρinv]
  have hsmall := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNM (inv_nonneg.mpr hD.le)
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hD.ne'] at hsmall
  exact ⟨inv_pos.mpr hD, hδρ, hδone, inv_inv D, hsmall⟩

theorem exists_oneSidedEndpointHeight_family
    {ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) {h : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {a b : Bool → ℝ} {l r ρ M H : ℝ}
    (hab : ∀ side, a side < b side)
    (hend : ∀ side, (if side then r else l) ∈ Icc (a side) (b side))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρwidth : 2 * ρ ≤ r - l) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hregular : ∀ i side, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (h i side)
      (Ioo (a side) (b side) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hroot : ∀ i side θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (h i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hpositive : ∀ i side θ, 0 < h i side (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hupper : ∀ i side θ, h i side (if side then r else l, θ) ≤ H)
    (hinverse : ∀ i side θ, (h i side (if side then r else l, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H)
    (hlog : ∀ i side j, 0 < j → j ≤ n → ∀ θ,
      |positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) (h i) side j θ| ≤ M)
    (hperiod : ∀ i side x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      h i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = h i side (x, θ))
    (heven : ∀ i side x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      h i side (x, -θ) = h i side (x, θ)) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
      δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M + 1) ∧
      ∀ i,
      let Q := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) (h i)
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q ∧
      (∀ p, 0 < Q p) ∧
      (∀ side k, k ≤ n → ∀ θ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q (if side then r else l, θ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (h i side) (if side then r else l, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Q (x, θ + Real.pi) = Q (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Q (x, -θ) = Q (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ p, p.1 ∉ Metric.ball l δ → p.1 ∉ Metric.ball r δ →
        Q =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ p, Q p ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 ∧ (Q p)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 := by
  let δ := oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth n ρ M
  obtain ⟨hδ, hδρ, hδone, hinv, hsmall⟩ :=
    oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth_margins n hρ hM
  have hgap : 2 * δ ≤ r - l := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδρ (by norm_num)).trans hρwidth
  have hRef : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : PolarPoint => (1 : ℝ)) := contDiff_const
  have hRefPos : ∀ _ : PolarPoint, (0 : ℝ) < 1 := fun _ => zero_lt_one
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hinv, ?_⟩
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hQ, hQpos⟩ := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_smooth_positive
    hRef hRefPos (hroot i) (hpositive i) n δ
  have hData (side : Bool) (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (hτ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ τ)
      (he : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ, h i side (x, τ θ) = h i side (x, θ))
      (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
      positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) (h i) side j (τ θ) =
        positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) (h i) side j θ := by
    have hlogroot (η : ℝ) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h i side))
        (if side then r else l, η) := by
      simpa only [boundaryHeightLogRatio, div_one] using
        (hroot i side η).log (hpositive i side η).ne'
    have heLog (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side)) (η : ℝ) :
        boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h i side) (x, τ η) =
          0 + 1 * boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h i side) (x, η) := by
      simpa only [boundaryHeightLogRatio, div_one, zero_add, one_mul] using
        congrArg Real.log (he x hx η)
    simpa only [positiveHeightTaylorData, ite_self, zero_add, one_mul] using
      radialBoundaryJet_angleAffine_on_closedStrip
        (hab side) (hend side) hlogroot hτ heLog j θ
  refine ⟨hQ, hQpos, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_one_germ n hδ (h i),
    positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_amplitude n hδ hδone hM hH
      (hpositive i) (hupper i) (hinverse i) (hlog i) hsmall⟩
  · intro side k hk θ
    exact iteratedFDeriv_eq_of_radialBoundaryJets_eq_on_closedStrip
      (hab side) hQ.contDiffOn (hregular i side) (hend side)
      (fun _ => hQ.contDiffAt) (hroot i side) (N := n)
      (fun j hj η => radialBoundaryJet_positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation
        hδ hgap hRef hRefPos (hroot i) (hpositive i) n side hj η) hk θ
  · exact positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_angleInvariant (fun θ => θ + Real.pi)
      (fun _ _ => rfl)
      (fun side j _ => hData side (fun θ => θ + Real.pi)
        (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const) (hperiod i side) j)
  · exact positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_angleInvariant (fun θ => -θ)
      (fun _ _ => rfl)
      (fun side j _ => hData side (fun θ => -θ) contDiff_neg (heven i side) j)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Finite logarithmic endpoint jets from actual positive height jets

The scalar logarithm envelope is evaluated at each genuine root point.
The one-sided smoothness identifies its radial trace with the ordinary
jet there; no smooth extension outside the physical strip is required.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem exists_oneSidedLogBoundaryJet_envelope (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ Clog : ℝ, 0 < Clog ∧ ∀ (H : ℝ), 1 ≤ H →
      ∀ (q : PolarPoint → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), a < b →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) → c ∈ Icc a b →
      (∀ θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ q (c, θ)) →
      (∀ p ∈ Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), 0 < q p) →
      (∀ θ, 0 < q (c, θ)) →
      (∀ θ, q (c, θ) ≤ H) → (∀ θ, (q (c, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H) →
      (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → ∀ θ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q (c, θ)‖ ≤ H) →
      ∀ j, j ≤ n → ∀ θ,
        |radialBoundaryJet (fun p => Real.log (q p)) c j θ| ≤
          Clog * H ^ (2 * n + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨Clog, hClog, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_log_finiteJet_polynomial_envelope (E := PolarPoint) n
  refine ⟨Clog, lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hClog, ?_⟩
  intro H hH q a b c hab hq hc hqroot hpos hposroot hupper hinverse hjets j hj θ
  have hlog : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => Real.log (q p))
      (Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    hq.log (fun p hp => (hpos p hp).ne')
  have hlogroot : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p => Real.log (q p)) (c, θ) :=
    (hqroot θ).log (hposroot θ).ne'
  have hrad := abs_mixedDerivative_le_norm_iteratedFDeriv_on_closedStrip
    hab hlog (p := (c, θ)) hc hlogroot j 0
  have hrad' : |radialBoundaryJet (fun p => Real.log (q p)) c j θ| ≤
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun p => Real.log (q p)) (c, θ)‖ := by
    simpa only [mixedDerivative, radialBoundaryJet, iteratedDeriv_zero, Nat.add_zero]
      using hrad
  exact hrad'.trans (hbound hH q (c, θ) (hqroot θ) (hposroot θ)
    (hupper θ) (hinverse θ) (fun k hk hkn => hjets k hk hkn θ) j hj)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# One common whole-component coordinate and height construction

The inputs are genuine one-sided endpoint fields and finite bounds on
their actual root jets. The coordinate and height are the displayed
integral/Taylor constructions. All collars are chosen before the family
index. Coordinate matching is through order n+1 and height matching
through order n. The reference member is exactly identity/one everywhere.

This finite assembly does not assert material growth for its input
constants or for the intermediate inverse-jet constant.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure WholePositiveTransportMatching (n : ℕ)
    (F : Bool → PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (q : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (Q : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (l r c d J H : ℝ) : Prop where
  geometry : WholeComponentTransportGeometry τ σ l r c d J
  height_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q
  height_positive : ∀ p, 0 < Q p
  coordinate_jets : ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ k τ (if side then r else l, θ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (F side) (if side then r else l, θ)
  height_jets : ∀ side k, k ≤ n → ∀ θ,
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q (if side then r else l, θ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (q side) (if side then r else l, θ)
  height_period : ∀ x θ, Q (x, θ + Real.pi) = Q (x, θ)
  height_even : ∀ x θ, Q (x, -θ) = Q (x, θ)
  height_middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Q =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  height_bound : ∀ p, Q p ≤ H ∧ (Q p)⁻¹ ≤ H

private theorem endpoint_projection_jet_bound
    {F : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {p : PolarPoint} {M : ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F p) (hbound : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k F p‖ ≤ M)
    (L : PolarPoint →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hL : ‖L‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (L ∘ F) p‖ ≤ M :=
  (L.norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_left hF (by simp : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞)).trans
    ((mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hL).trans hbound)

theorem exists_wholePositiveTransport_family
    {ι : Type*} (i₀ : ι) (n : ℕ)
    {F : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {q : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {a b : Bool → ℝ} {l r c d κφ κX M H : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκφ : 0 < κφ) (hκφone : κφ ≤ 1) (hκX : 0 < κX)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hdata : ∀ i side, OneSidedTransportEndpoint (F i side) (q i side)
      (a side) (b side) (if side then r else l))
    (hangle : ∀ i side θ, κφ ≤ angularPartial (fun p => (F i side p).2)
      (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hradial : ∀ i side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (fun p => (F i side p).1)
      (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hjets : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 2 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (F i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hupper : ∀ i side θ, q i side (if side then r else l, θ) ≤ H)
    (hinverse : ∀ i side θ, (q i side (if side then r else l, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H)
    (hqjets : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (q i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ H)
    (href : ∀ side θ,
      F i₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) ∧
      q i₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) :
    let ρ := min ((r - l) / 4) (min (c - l) (r - d))
    ∃ Clog Mσ δ : ℝ, 0 < Clog ∧ 1 ≤ Mσ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
      δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Clog * H ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) ∧
      0 < endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ ∧
      ∀ i,
      let ψ := fun side p => (F i side p).2
      let X := fun side p => (F i side p).1
      let τ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransport n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let σ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let Q := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) (q i)
      WholePositiveTransportMatching n (F i) (q i) τ σ Q l r c d
        (endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ * (κφ / 2)) (Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2) ∧
        (i = i₀ → τ = id ∧ σ = id ∧ Q = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) := by
  let ψ : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i side p => (F i side p).2
  let X : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i side p => (F i side p).1
  have hab (side : Bool) : a side < b side := (hdata i₀ side).interval
  have hend (side : Bool) : (if side then r else l) ∈ Icc (a side) (b side) :=
    (hdata i₀ side).endpoint
  have hψjets (i : ι) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
      (hkn : k ≤ n + 2) (θ : ℝ) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (ψ i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
    simpa only [ψ, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', Function.comp_def] using
      endpoint_projection_jet_bound ((hdata i side).root_smooth θ)
        (hjets i side k hk hkn θ) (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_snd_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
  have hXjets (i : ι) (side : Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
      (hkn : k ≤ n + 1) (θ : ℝ) :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
    simpa only [X, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', Function.comp_def] using
      endpoint_projection_jet_bound ((hdata i side).root_smooth θ)
        (hjets i side k hk (by omega) θ) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_fst_le ℝ ℝ ℝ)
  have hperiod (i : ι) (side : Bool) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side))
      (θ : ℝ) : F i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = F i side (x, θ) + (0, Real.pi) := by
    simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] using
      (hdata i side).period_add (x, θ) ⟨hx, mem_univ _⟩
  have hreflect (i : ι) (side : Bool) (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side))
      (θ : ℝ) : F i side (x, -θ) = ((F i side (x, θ)).1, -(F i side (x, θ)).2) :=
    (hdata i side).reflect (x, θ) ⟨hx, mem_univ _⟩
  have ht := exists_oneSidedWholeComponentTransport_family n hlc hcd hdr hab hend
    hκφ hκφone hκX hM
    (fun i side => (hdata i side).smooth_on.snd)
    (fun i side θ => ((hdata i side).root_smooth θ).snd) hangle hψjets
    (fun i side x hx θ => by
      simpa only [ψ, Prod.snd_add] using congrArg Prod.snd (hperiod i side x hx θ))
    (fun i side x hx θ => congrArg Prod.snd (hreflect i side x hx θ))
    (fun i side => (hdata i side).smooth_on.fst)
    (fun i side θ => ((hdata i side).root_smooth θ).fst)
    (fun i side => (hdata i side).root_radial) hradial hXjets
    (fun i side x hx θ => by
      simpa only [X, Prod.fst_add, add_zero] using congrArg Prod.fst (hperiod i side x hx θ))
    (fun i side x hx θ => congrArg Prod.fst (hreflect i side x hx θ))
  dsimp only at ht
  rcases ht with ⟨_, _, _, _, _, Mσ, hMσ, hη, hηgap, hB, ht⟩
  let ρ : ℝ := min ((r - l) / 4) (min (c - l) (r - d))
  have hlr : l < r := hlc.trans (hcd.trans hdr)
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := lt_min (div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlr) (by norm_num))
    (lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hlc) (sub_pos.mpr hdr))
  have hρwidth : 2 * ρ ≤ r - l := by
    have h := min_le_left ((r - l) / 4) (min (c - l) (r - d))
    dsimp only [ρ]
    linarith
  have hρleft : ρ ≤ c - l :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρright : ρ ≤ r - d :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨Clog, hClog, hlogbound⟩ := exists_oneSidedLogBoundaryJet_envelope n
  let Mlog : ℝ := Clog * H ^ (2 * n + 1)
  have hMlog : 0 ≤ Mlog := mul_nonneg hClog.le (pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hH) _)
  have hlog (i : ι) (side : Bool) (j : ℕ) (_hj : 0 < j) (hjn : j ≤ n) (θ : ℝ) :
      |positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) (q i) side j θ| ≤ Mlog := by
    simpa only [positiveHeightTaylorData, boundaryHeightLogRatio, div_one, Mlog] using
      hlogbound H hH (q i side) (a side) (b side) (if side then r else l)
        (hab side) (hdata i side).height_smooth_on (hend side)
        (fun η => ((hdata i side).height_root η).1) (hdata i side).height_positive
        (fun η => ((hdata i side).height_root η).2) (hupper i side) (hinverse i side)
        (hqjets i side) j hjn θ
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hQ⟩ := exists_oneSidedEndpointHeight_family n
    hab hend hρ hρwidth hMlog hH
    (fun i side => (hdata i side).height_smooth_on)
    (fun i side θ => ((hdata i side).height_root θ).1)
    (fun i side θ => ((hdata i side).height_root θ).2)
    hupper hinverse hlog
    (fun i side x hx θ => by
      simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] using
        (hdata i side).height_period (x, θ) ⟨hx, mem_univ _⟩)
    (fun i side x hx θ => (hdata i side).height_even (x, θ) ⟨hx, mem_univ _⟩)
  refine ⟨Clog, Mσ, δ, hClog, hMσ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hB, ?_⟩
  intro i
  dsimp only
  rcases ht i with ⟨hgeometry, _, _, hboundary⟩
  rcases hQ i with ⟨hQsmooth, hQpos, hQjets, hQperiod, hQeven, hQmiddle, hQbound⟩
  constructor
  · refine {
      geometry := hgeometry
      height_smooth := hQsmooth
      height_positive := hQpos
      coordinate_jets := ?_
      height_jets := hQjets
      height_period := hQperiod
      height_even := hQeven
      height_middle_germ := ?_
      height_bound := hQbound }
    · intro side k hk θ
      simpa only [X, ψ, Prod.eta] using hboundary side k hk θ
    · intro x hx θ
      apply hQmiddle (x, θ)
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
        apply not_lt.mpr
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hlc.le.trans hx.1))]
        exact (hδρ.trans hρleft).trans (sub_le_sub_right hx.1 l)
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
        apply not_lt.mpr
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (hx.2.trans hdr.le))]
        have h := hδρ.trans hρright
        linarith [hx.2]
  · intro hi
    subst i
    have hψref (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) : ψ i₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)]
        (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [(href side θ).1] with p hp
      exact congrArg Prod.snd hp
    have hXref (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) : X i₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then r else l, θ)]
        (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [(href side θ).1] with p hp
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hp
    have hid := oneSidedWholeComponentTransport_reference_identity
      (κφ := κφ) (κX := κX) (M := M) (Mσ := Mσ) n hψref hXref hη hηgap
    exact ⟨hid.1, hid.2, positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_reference_one n l r δ
      (fun side θ => (href side θ).2)⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# The actual whole-positive-component transport from finite endpoint data

Only finitely many ordinary jets of the actual stored endpoint fields
are bounded as inputs. The one-sided geometry, angular symmetries and
reference identity germs are derived from the actual atlas factory.
The certified endpoint source is fixed before the state; an ambient
endpoint is allowed and contributes identity/one.

The common constants below are an interface for the separate material
endpoint estimates. No global transport, positive atlas, or primitive
bound is an assumption of this finite construction.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure WholePositiveEndpointJetBounds (n : ℕ)
    (F : Bool → PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (q : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (l r κφ κX M H : ℝ) : Prop where
  angular_lower : ∀ side θ, κφ ≤ angularPartial (fun p => (F side p).2)
    (if side then r else l, θ)
  radial_lower : ∀ side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (fun p => (F side p).1)
    (if side then r else l, θ)
  coordinate_jets : ∀ side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 2 → ∀ θ,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (F side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M
  height_value : ∀ side θ, q side (if side then r else l, θ) ≤ H
  height_inverse : ∀ side θ, (q side (if side then r else l, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H
  height_jets : ∀ side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → ∀ θ,
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (q side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ H

theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositive_transport_of_endpoint_bounds
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    (n : ℕ) (i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w))
    (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    {c d κφ κX M H : ℝ}
    (hlc : n04PositiveLeft i < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < n04PositiveRight i)
    (hκφ : 0 < κφ) (hκφone : κφ ≤ 1) (hκX : 0 < κX) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 →
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
      WholePositiveEndpointJetBounds n
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z)
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z)
        (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) κφ κX M H) :
    let l := n04PositiveLeft i
    let r := n04PositiveRight i
    let ρ := min ((r - l) / 4) (min (c - l) (r - d))
    ∃ Clog Mσ δ : ℝ, 0 < Clog ∧ 1 ≤ Mσ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
      δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Clog * H ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) ∧
      0 < endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ ∧
      ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 →
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
      let F := fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z
      let q := fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z
      let ψ := fun side p => (F side p).2
      let X := fun side p => (F side p).1
      let τ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransport n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let σ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let Q := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) q
      WholePositiveTransportMatching n F q τ σ Q l r c d
        (endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ * (κφ / 2)) (Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2) ∧
        (z = (C.referenceState, 0) → τ = id ∧ σ = id ∧ Q = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let Z := {z : AnnularState S × ℝ //
    z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε ∧ stateSector S z.1}
  let z₀ : Z := ⟨(C.referenceState, 0),
    reference_mem_stateNeighborhood S C base hN.1.1.2.1, hN.1.1.2.2.1.stateSector⟩
  let a : Bool → ℝ := fun side => n04PositiveSourceLeft (j side)
  let b : Bool → ℝ := fun side => n04PositiveSourceRight (j side)
  let F : Z → Bool → PolarPoint → PolarPoint := fun z side =>
    n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z.1
  let q : Z → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun z side =>
    n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z.1
  have hdata (z : Z) (side : Bool) :
      OneSidedTransportEndpoint (F z side) (q z side) (a side) (b side)
        (if side then n04PositiveRight i else n04PositiveLeft i) :=
    n04Coordinates_actualAtlas_positiveEndpoint_of_source
      hT hS hN hfield e (j side) z.2.1 z.2.2
  have hfinite (z : Z) : WholePositiveEndpointJetBounds n (F z) (q z)
      (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) κφ κX M H :=
    hbound z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2
  have href (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      F z₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then n04PositiveRight i else n04PositiveLeft i, θ)]
          (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) ∧
      q z₀ side =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then n04PositiveRight i else n04PositiveLeft i, θ)]
          (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) :=
    n04Coordinates_positiveSource_reference_germs hT hS hN hfield e (j side) θ
  have hout := exists_wholePositiveTransport_family (F := F) (q := q) (a := a) (b := b)
    (l := n04PositiveLeft i) (r := n04PositiveRight i) z₀ n
    hlc hcd hdr hκφ hκφone hκX hM hH hdata
    (fun z => (hfinite z).angular_lower) (fun z => (hfinite z).radial_lower)
    (fun z => (hfinite z).coordinate_jets) (fun z => (hfinite z).height_value)
    (fun z => (hfinite z).height_inverse) (fun z => (hfinite z).height_jets) href
  dsimp only at hout ⊢
  rcases hout with ⟨Clog, Mσ, δ, hClog, hMσ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hB, hout⟩
  refine ⟨Clog, Mσ, δ, hClog, hMσ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hB, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hs
  dsimp only
  let z' : Z := ⟨z, hz, hs⟩
  have hzout := hout z'
  refine ⟨hzout.1, ?_⟩
  intro he
  exact hzout.2 (Subtype.ext he)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Matching the constructed positive transport to the actual negative roots

A certified positive endpoint source cannot select a different negative
component at the same root: the true closed negative intervals are
disjoint. An ambient source cannot occur at an interior negative root.
This identifies the actual stored chart and height germ, and the finite
positive construction then matches its genuine negative neighbor.

The final constructor takes only the original finite endpoint bounds.
No root-matching or global-transport conclusion is assumed.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

theorem n04PositiveEndpointSource_eq_some_of_negative_endpoint
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    {i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)} {side : Bool}
    (j : N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side) (m : ℕ)
    (hroot : n04PositiveEndpoint i side = (if side then C.left m else C.right m)) :
    j.val = some m := by
  have hC : controlGeometryConditions D S C := hN.2.2.2.1
  rcases j with ⟨o, ho⟩
  cases o with
  | none =>
      exfalso
      change n04PositiveEndpoint i side = (if side then D.b else D.a) at ho
      have he := hroot.symm.trans ho
      cases side
      · change C.right m = D.a at he
        exact ((hC.1 m).1.trans (hC.1 m).2.1).ne' he
      · change C.left m = D.b at he
        exact ((hC.1 m).2.1.trans (hC.1 m).2.2).ne he
  | some k =>
      change n04PositiveEndpoint i side = (if side then C.left k else C.right k) at ho
      have he := ho.symm.trans hroot
      have hk : (if side then C.left k else C.right k) ∈ Icc (C.left k) (C.right k) := by
        cases side
        · exact ⟨(hC.1 k).2.1.le, le_rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨le_rfl, (hC.1 k).2.1.le⟩
      have hm : (if side then C.left k else C.right k) ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) := by
        rw [he]
        cases side
        · exact ⟨(hC.1 m).2.1.le, le_rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨le_rfl, (hC.1 m).2.1.le⟩
      exact congrArg some (n04_negativeClosed_index_unique hN hk hm)

theorem n04PositiveSource_negative_root_germs
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε) (K : CanonicalData S)
    (z : AnnularState S × ℝ)
    (i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w))
    (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side) (m : ℕ) (side : Bool)
    (hadj : n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side) = (if side then C.right m else C.left m))
    (θ : ℝ) :
    (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)]
      n04PositiveSourceMap (j (!side)) K z) ∧
    (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m =ᶠ[𝓝 (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)]
      n04PositiveSourceHeight (j (!side)) K z) := by
  have hroot : n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side) =
      (if !side then C.left m else C.right m) := by
    cases side <;> exact hadj
  have hj := n04PositiveEndpointSource_eq_some_of_negative_endpoint hN (j (!side)) m hroot
  simp only [n04PositiveSourceMap, n04PositiveSourceHeight, hj]
  have hab : C.left m < C.right m := (hN.2.2.2.1.1 m).2.1
  have hτ := closedComponentField_root_germ
    (fun b => canonicalCurrentPoint C K z (if b then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1))
    hab side θ
  have hQ := closedComponentField_root_germ
    (fun b => n04CoordinatesCurrentHeightRatio C K z
      (if b then (K.cutPair m).2 else (K.cutPair m).1)) hab side θ
  cases side <;> exact ⟨hτ, hQ⟩

def WholePositiveNegativeRootJets
    {D : ReferenceData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData} (n : ℕ)
    (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (K : CanonicalData S) (z : AnnularState S × ℝ)
    (i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w))
    (τ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (Q : PolarPoint → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m side, n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side) = (if side then C.right m else C.left m) →
    (∀ θ k, k ≤ n + 1 →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m)
          (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k τ (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ)) ∧
    (∀ θ k, k ≤ n →
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (canonicalWholeNegativeHeightRatio C K z m)
          (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q (if side then C.right m else C.left m, θ))

theorem wholePositiveTransportMatching_negative_root_jets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    {K : CanonicalData S} {z : AnnularState S × ℝ}
    {i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w)}
    (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {c d J H : ℝ}
    (hm : WholePositiveTransportMatching n
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z)
      (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z)
      τ σ Q (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) c d J H) :
    WholePositiveNegativeRootJets n C K z i τ Q := by
  intro m side hadj
  constructor
  · intro θ k hk
    have hjet := hm.coordinate_jets (!side) k hk θ
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ k τ (n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side), θ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (n04PositiveSourceMap (j (!side)) K z)
        (n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side), θ) at hjet
    rw [hadj] at hjet
    have hg := (n04PositiveSource_negative_root_germs hN K z i j m side hadj θ).1
    exact (hg.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds.trans hjet.symm
  · intro θ k hk
    have hjet := hm.height_jets (!side) k hk θ
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q (n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side), θ) =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (n04PositiveSourceHeight (j (!side)) K z)
        (n04PositiveEndpoint i (!side), θ) at hjet
    rw [hadj] at hjet
    have hg := (n04PositiveSource_negative_root_germs hN K z i j m side hadj θ).2
    exact (hg.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds.trans hjet.symm

theorem n04Coordinates_wholePositive_transport_with_negative_root_jets
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε) (e : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D)
    (n : ℕ) (i : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w))
    (j : ∀ side, N04PositiveEndpointSource C i side)
    {c d κφ κX M H : ℝ}
    (hlc : n04PositiveLeft i < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < n04PositiveRight i)
    (hκφ : 0 < κφ) (hκφone : κφ ≤ 1) (hκX : 0 < κX) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 →
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
      WholePositiveEndpointJetBounds n
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z)
        (fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z)
        (n04PositiveLeft i) (n04PositiveRight i) κφ κX M H) :
    let l := n04PositiveLeft i
    let r := n04PositiveRight i
    let ρ := min ((r - l) / 4) (min (c - l) (r - d))
    ∃ Clog Mσ δ : ℝ, 0 < Clog ∧ 1 ≤ Mσ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
      δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Clog * H ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) ∧
      0 < endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ ∧
      ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, stateSector S z.1 →
      let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
      let F := fun side => n04PositiveSourceMap (j side) K z
      let q := fun side => n04PositiveSourceHeight (j side) K z
      let ψ := fun side p => (F side p).2
      let X := fun side p => (F side p).1
      let τ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransport n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let σ := oneSidedWholeComponentTransportInverse n ψ X l r c d κφ κX M Mσ
      let Q := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) q
      WholePositiveTransportMatching n F q τ σ Q l r c d
          (endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ * (κφ / 2)) (Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2) ∧
        (z = (C.referenceState, 0) → τ = id ∧ σ = id ∧ Q = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) ∧
        WholePositiveNegativeRootJets n C K z i τ Q := by
  have hout := n04Coordinates_wholePositive_transport_of_endpoint_bounds
    hT hS hN hfield e n i j hlc hcd hdr hκφ hκφone hκX hM hH hbound
  dsimp only at hout ⊢
  rcases hout with ⟨Clog, Mσ, δ, hClog, hMσ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hB, hout⟩
  refine ⟨Clog, Mσ, δ, hClog, hMσ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hrecip, hB, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hs
  dsimp only
  have hzout := hout z hz hs
  exact ⟨hzout.1, hzout.2, wholePositiveTransportMatching_negative_root_jets hN.1.1 j hzout.1⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual positive charts from the constructed whole-component transport

The chart is the displayed inverse transport, and its height is the
reciprocal of the constructed relative height at that inverse point.
All assertions below concern these actual functions. They do not force
unit principal density or assume the final canonical operator identity.
This is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def wholePositiveChartHeight (σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (Q : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (p : PolarPoint) : ℝ := (Q (σ p))⁻¹

structure WholePositiveChartGeometry
    (F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (h : PolarPoint → ℝ) (l r c d : ℝ) : Prop where
  chart_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F
  inverse_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G
  height_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h
  height_positive : ∀ p, 0 < h p
  left_inverse : Function.LeftInverse G F
  right_inverse : Function.RightInverse G F
  jacobian_positive : ∀ p, 0 < planeJacobian F p
  bijOn : BijOn F (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  maps_open : MapsTo F (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  inverse_maps_open : MapsTo G
    (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  maps_closed : MapsTo F (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  inverse_maps_closed : MapsTo G
    (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  period_add : ∀ p, F (p + (0, Real.pi)) = F p + (0, Real.pi)
  inverse_period_add : ∀ p, G (p + (0, Real.pi)) = G p + (0, Real.pi)
  height_period : ∀ p, h (p + (0, Real.pi)) = h p
  reflect : ∀ p, F (p.1, -p.2) = ((F p).1, -(F p).2)
  inverse_reflect : ∀ p, G (p.1, -p.2) = ((G p).1, -(G p).2)
  height_even : ∀ p, h (p.1, -p.2) = h p
  jacobian_even : ∀ p, planeJacobian F (p.1, -p.2) = planeJacobian F p
  middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, F =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  inverse_middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ,
    G =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  height_middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, h =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  boundary_inverse : ∀ p, CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm F G p

theorem wholePositiveChartGeometry_of_transport
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d J : ℝ}
    (hgeometry : WholeComponentTransportGeometry τ σ l r c d J)
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQpos : ∀ p, 0 < Q p)
    (hQperiod : ∀ x θ, Q (x, θ + Real.pi) = Q (x, θ))
    (hQeven : ∀ x θ, Q (x, -θ) = Q (x, θ))
    (hQmiddle : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Q =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) :
    WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d := by
  have hJ (p : PolarPoint) : 0 < planeJacobian σ p := by
    have hinverse : τ ∘ σ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall hgeometry.right_inverse
    have hprod := planeJacobian_inverse_mul_of_germ
      (hgeometry.inverse_smooth.differentiable (by simp) p)
      (hgeometry.smooth.differentiable (by simp) (σ p)) hinverse
    by_contra hnot
    have hnonpos := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos
      (hgeometry.jacobian_positive (σ p)).le (le_of_not_gt hnot)
    rw [hprod] at hnonpos
    exact (not_le_of_gt zero_lt_one) hnonpos
  have hQP (p : PolarPoint) : Q (p + (0, Real.pi)) = Q p := by
    rcases p with ⟨x, θ⟩
    simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] using hQperiod x θ
  have hheight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) :=
    (hQ.comp hgeometry.inverse_smooth).inv (fun p => (hQpos (σ p)).ne')
  have hleft : Function.LeftInverse τ σ := hgeometry.right_inverse
  have hbij : BijOn σ (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    ⟨hgeometry.inverse_maps_open, hleft.injective.injOn,
      fun p hp => ⟨τ p, hgeometry.maps_open hp, hgeometry.left_inverse p⟩⟩
  refine {
    chart_smooth := hgeometry.inverse_smooth
    inverse_smooth := hgeometry.smooth
    height_smooth := hheight
    height_positive := fun p => inv_pos.mpr (hQpos (σ p))
    left_inverse := hgeometry.right_inverse
    right_inverse := hgeometry.left_inverse
    jacobian_positive := hJ
    bijOn := hbij
    maps_open := hgeometry.inverse_maps_open
    inverse_maps_open := hgeometry.maps_open
    maps_closed := hgeometry.inverse_maps_closed
    inverse_maps_closed := hgeometry.maps_closed
    period_add := hgeometry.inverse_period_add
    inverse_period_add := hgeometry.period_add
    height_period := ?_
    reflect := hgeometry.inverse_reflect
    inverse_reflect := hgeometry.reflect
    height_even := ?_
    jacobian_even := planeJacobian_even_of_angle_reflection
      (hgeometry.inverse_smooth.differentiable (by simp)) hgeometry.inverse_reflect
    middle_germ := hgeometry.inverse_middle_germ
    inverse_middle_germ := hgeometry.middle_germ
    height_middle_germ := ?_
    boundary_inverse := fun p => canonicalBoundaryInverseGerm_of_global_leftInverse
      hgeometry.inverse_smooth.contDiffAt (hJ p).ne' hgeometry.right_inverse }
  · intro p
    change (Q (σ (p + (0, Real.pi))))⁻¹ = (Q (σ p))⁻¹
    rw [hgeometry.inverse_period_add, hQP]
  · intro p
    change (Q (σ (p.1, -p.2)))⁻¹ = (Q (σ p))⁻¹
    rw [hgeometry.inverse_reflect, hQeven]
  · intro x hx θ
    filter_upwards [hgeometry.inverse_middle_germ x hx θ, hQmiddle x hx θ] with p hpσ hpQ
    change (Q (σ p))⁻¹ = 1
    rw [hpσ, hpQ, inv_one]

theorem wholePositiveChartGeometry_of_matching
    {n : ℕ} {F : Bool → PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {q : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d J H : ℝ}
    (h : WholePositiveTransportMatching n F q τ σ Q l r c d J H) :
    WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d :=
  wholePositiveChartGeometry_of_transport h.geometry h.height_smooth
    h.height_positive h.height_period h.height_even h.height_middle_germ

/-- The relative height is the one already constructed, at the same
reference point. No total inverse is evaluated outside its true formula. -/
theorem wholePositiveChartHeight_reference_ratio
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} (Q : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (hleft : Function.LeftInverse σ τ) (p : PolarPoint) :
    1 / wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q (τ p) = Q p := by
  simp only [wholePositiveChartHeight, hleft p, one_div, inv_inv]

theorem wholePositiveChartHeight_bound
    {σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {H : ℝ}
    (hQ : ∀ p, Q p ≤ H ∧ (Q p)⁻¹ ≤ H) (p : PolarPoint) :
    wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q p ≤ H ∧
      (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q p)⁻¹ ≤ H := by
  exact ⟨(hQ (σ p)).2, by simpa only [wholePositiveChartHeight, inv_inv] using (hQ (σ p)).1⟩

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

/-!
# Actual fields of a whole positive canonical piece

The chart is the inverse transport, its inverse is the transport, and its
height is the reciprocal relative height at the chart point.  The standard
open, closed, and normalization clauses follow from these actual maps.
The coefficient and potential fields use the actual coordinate formulas.
At the reference member they retain the physical coefficient field.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

theorem WholePositiveChartGeometry.open_fields
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d : ℝ}
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry F G h l r c d) :
    MapsTo F (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ∧

    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hτ : τ = id) (hσ : σ = id) (hQ : Q = (fun _ => 1)) :

    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint}
    {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d : ℝ}
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d)
    {p : PolarPoint}

    (hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ A.c (τ p))
    (W : PolarPoint → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) :
    -(wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q (τ p) *
        divergenceOperator A (fun x => wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q x * W (σ x))

      -divergenceOperator (wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients A τ σ Q) W p +
        wholePositiveCanonicalPotential A τ σ Q p * W p := by
  have hi : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (τ p), τ (σ x) = x :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall H.left_inverse

    (A := A) (F := σ) (G := τ) (h := wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) (x := τ p)

    H.height_smooth.contDiffAt hW (H.jacobian_positive (τ p)).ne' hi
  rw [H.right_inverse p] at hop
  dsimp only [wholePositiveCanonicalCoefficients, wholePositiveCanonicalPotential]

private theorem equivariance_on_closed_strip_of_open
    {E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [T2Space E] {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (F : PolarPoint → E)
    (σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (Ψ : E → E)
    (hr : ∀ p, (σ p).1 = p.1) (hσ : Continuous σ) (hΨ : Continuous Ψ)
    (hF : ∀ p, p.1 ∈ Icc a b → ContinuousAt F p)
    (he : ∀ p, p.1 ∈ Ioo a b → F (σ p) = Ψ (F p))
    {p : PolarPoint} (hp : p.1 ∈ Icc a b) : F (σ p) = Ψ (F p) := by
  let U : Set PolarPoint := Ioo a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)
  have hpU : p ∈ closure U := by
    simpa only [U, closure_prod_eq, closure_Ioo hab.ne, closure_univ] using
      (show p ∈ Icc a b ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) from ⟨hp, mem_univ _⟩)
  haveI : NeBot (𝓝[U] p) := mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp hpU
  have hs : (σ p).1 ∈ Icc a b := by simpa only [hr p] using hp
  have hleft : ContinuousAt (F ∘ σ) p := (hF (σ p) hs).comp hσ.continuousAt
  have hright : ContinuousAt (Ψ ∘ F) p := hΨ.continuousAt.comp (hF p hp)
  have hnear : (F ∘ σ) =ᶠ[𝓝[U] p] (Ψ ∘ F) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with q hq
    exact he q hq.1
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique_of_eventuallyEq
    (hleft.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) (hright.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) hnear

theorem canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_symmetries_closed
    {p : PolarPoint} (hp : p ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
    canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m (p + (0, Real.pi)) =
        canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m p + (0, Real.pi) ∧
      canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m (p.1, -p.2) =
        ((canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m p).1,
          -(canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m p).2) := by
  let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e
  let τ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint := canonicalWholeNegativeTransport C K z m
  have hab : C.left m < C.right m := (hN.1.1.2.2.2.1.1 m).2.1
  have hτ (q : PolarPoint) (hq : q.1 ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m)) :
      ContinuousAt τ q :=
    (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_closed_regular hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m
      ⟨hq, mem_univ _⟩).1.continuousAt
  have he : EqOn τ (n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelTransition S C L z m)
      (Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) :=
    (canonicalWholeNegativeTransport_eq_travel hT hS hN hfield e hz hs m).1
  constructor
  · refine equivariance_on_closed_strip_of_open hab τ
      (fun q => q + (0, Real.pi)) (fun q => q + (0, Real.pi))
      (fun q => by simp only [Prod.fst_add, add_zero])
      (continuous_id.add continuous_const) (continuous_id.add continuous_const) hτ ?_ (p := p) hp.1
    intro q hq
    have hqU : q ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hq, mem_univ _⟩
    have hqS : q + (0, Real.pi) ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=

    exact (n04CoordinatesNegativeTravelTransition_symmetries hT hS hN hfield hz hs m hqU).1
  · refine equivariance_on_closed_strip_of_open hab τ
      (fun q => (q.1, -q.2)) (fun q => (q.1, -q.2)) (fun _ => rfl)
      (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd.neg) (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd.neg)
      hτ ?_ (p := p) hp.1
    intro q hq
    have hqU : q ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hq, mem_univ _⟩
    have hqR : (q.1, -q.2) ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) :=
